title: The Book of Judges Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Judges — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?
verses.decoded: After Joshua died, the people of Israel asked the LORD, "Who will go up first to fight against the Canaanites for us?"

verses.kjv: And the LORD said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said, Judah will go up; look, I have given the land into his hand.

verses.kjv: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.
verses.decoded: And Judah said to Simeon his brother, Come with me into my territory, so that we can fight against the Canaanites; and I will also go with you into your territory. So Simeon went with him.

verses.kjv: And Judah went up; and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.
verses.decoded: Judah went up, and the LORD gave the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hands; they killed ten thousand of them in Bezek.

verses.kjv: And they found Adonibezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
verses.decoded: They found Adoni-bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him, killing the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

verses.kjv: But Adonibezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.
verses.decoded: But Adoni-bezek ran away; they chased him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.

verses.kjv: And Adonibezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.
verses.decoded: And Adoni-bezek said, Seventy kings, who had their thumbs and big toes cut off, gathered their food under my table: as I have done to them, so God has rewarded me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.

verses.kjv: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
verses.decoded: Now the descendants of Judah fought against Jerusalem, captured it, killed the people with the sword, and burned the city down.

verses.kjv: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.
verses.decoded: After that, the people of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the mountains, in the south, and in the valley.

verses.kjv: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.
verses.decoded: Judah attacked the Canaanites living in Hebron. (The name of Hebron used to be Kirjath-arba.) They killed Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.

verses.kjv: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher:
verses.decoded: And from there he went against the people living in Debir; and the name of Debir was formerly Kirjath-sepher.

verses.kjv: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
verses.decoded: And Caleb said, Whoever attacks Kirjath-sepher and captures it, I will give him my daughter Achsah as a wife.

verses.kjv: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
verses.decoded: And Othniel, the son of Kenaz and Caleb’s younger brother, captured it; and he gave him Achsah, his daughter, as a wife.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when she came to him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wilt thou?
verses.decoded: When she came to him, she persuaded him to ask her father for a field. She got down from her donkey, and Caleb said to her, "What do you want?"

verses.kjv: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.
verses.decoded: And she said to him, Give me a blessing, because you have given me a southern land; also give me springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

verses.kjv: And the children of the Kenite, Moses’ father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which lieth in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.
verses.decoded: The descendants of the Kenite, Moses’ father-in-law, left the city of palm trees with the people of Judah and went into the wilderness of Judah, which is located south of Arad; and they went and lived among the people.

verses.kjv: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.
verses.decoded: Judah went with his brother Simeon, and they killed the Canaanites who lived in Zephath, and completely destroyed the city. The city was then called Hormah.

verses.kjv: Also Judah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.
verses.decoded: Also Judah captured Gaza and its surrounding territory, and Askelon and its surrounding territory, and Ekron and its surrounding territory.

verses.kjv: And the LORD was with Judah; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
verses.decoded: The LORD was with Judah, and he forced out the people living in the mountains, but he could not force out the people living in the valley because they had iron chariots.

verses.kjv: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak.
verses.decoded: They gave Hebron to Caleb, just as Moses had said, and he drove out the three sons of Anak from there.

verses.kjv: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.
verses.decoded: The people of Benjamin did not force out the Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem; instead, the Jebusites live together with the people of Benjamin in Jerusalem up to this time.

verses.kjv: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Bethel: and the LORD was with them.
verses.decoded: The family of Joseph also went up to attack Bethel, and the LORD was with them.

verses.kjv: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)
verses.decoded: The family of Joseph sent people to scout out Bethel. (The city was previously called Luz.)

verses.kjv: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will shew thee mercy.
verses.decoded: And the spies saw a man come out of the city, and they said to him, Please show us the entrance to the city, and we will show you kindness.

verses.kjv: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.
verses.decoded: And when he showed them the entrance into the city, they struck the city with the edge of the sword; but they spared the man and all his family.

verses.kjv: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which is the name thereof unto this day.
verses.decoded: The man went into the land of the Hittites, built a city, and named it Luz; that is the name it has to this day.

verses.kjv: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Bethshean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
verses.decoded: Manasseh did not drive out the people living in Beth-shean and its towns, nor in Taanach and its towns, nor the people living in Dor and its towns, nor the people living in Ibleam and its towns, nor the people living in Megiddo and its towns; instead, the Canaanites continued to live in that land.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.
verses.decoded: When Israel became strong, they forced the Canaanites to pay tribute but did not completely drive them out.

verses.kjv: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.
verses.decoded: Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer; instead, the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.

verses.kjv: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.
verses.decoded: Zebulun did not force out the people living in Kitron, nor the people living in Nahalol; instead, the Canaanites lived among them and paid tribute.

verses.kjv: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:
verses.decoded: Asher did not drive out the people living in Accho, nor the people living in Zidon, nor in Ahlab, nor in Achzib, nor in Helbah, nor in Aphik, nor in Rehob.

verses.kjv: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.
verses.decoded: But the people of Asher lived among the Canaanites, the people who lived in the land, because they did not force them to leave.

verses.kjv: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Bethshemesh, nor the inhabitants of Bethanath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Bethshemesh and of Bethanath became tributaries unto them.
verses.decoded: Naphtali did not drive out the people living in Beth-shemesh, nor the people living in Beth-anath; instead, he lived among the Canaanites, the people living in the land. However, the people of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath became subject to them and paid tribute.

verses.kjv: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain: for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:
verses.decoded: And the Amorites pushed the people of Dan into the mountains because they would not allow them to come down into the valley.

verses.kjv: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.
verses.decoded: But the Amorites lived on Mount Heres in Aijalon and in Shaalbim; still, the power of the house of Joseph was strong, so they became subjects who paid tribute.

verses.kjv: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
verses.decoded: And the territory of the Amorites was from the ascent to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.

verses.kjv: And an angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.
verses.decoded: An angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal to Bochim and said, I brought you up out of Egypt and brought you to the land I promised your ancestors; and I said, I will never break my agreement with you.

verses.kjv: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land; ye shall throw down their altars: but ye have not obeyed my voice: why have ye done this?
verses.decoded: And you must not make any agreement with the people living in this land; you must destroy their altars: but you have not obeyed my command: why have you done this?

verses.kjv: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be as thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.
verses.decoded: Therefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; instead, they will be like thorns in your sides, and their gods will be a trap for you.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the angel of the LORD spake these words unto all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.
verses.decoded: When the angel of the LORD spoke these words to all the people of Israel, the people raised their voices and cried.

verses.kjv: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: They named that place Bochim, and they offered sacrifices to the LORD there.

verses.kjv: And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.
verses.decoded: When Joshua dismissed the people, the Israelites each went to their own inheritance to take possession of the land.

verses.kjv: And the people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the LORD, that he did for Israel.
verses.decoded: The people worshiped the LORD throughout the lifetime of Joshua and during the lives of the elders who lived longer than Joshua, who had witnessed all the amazing things the LORD did for Israel.

verses.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being an hundred and ten years old.
verses.decoded: Joshua, the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of one hundred and ten years.

verses.kjv: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathheres, in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.
verses.decoded: They buried him at the boundary of his inheritance in Timnath-heres, on the mountain of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.

verses.kjv: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, which knew not the LORD, nor yet the works which he had done for Israel.
verses.decoded: And all that generation died and were buried with their ancestors; then a new generation came after them who did not know the LORD or the things he had done for Israel.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim:
verses.decoded: The people of Israel did what was wrong in the eyes of the LORD and worshiped Baalim.

verses.kjv: And they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the LORD to anger.
verses.decoded: They abandoned the LORD God of their ancestors, who had brought them out of Egypt, and they followed other gods, the gods of the surrounding peoples, and they bowed down to them, which angered the LORD.

verses.kjv: And they forsook the LORD, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.
verses.decoded: They abandoned the LORD and worshiped Baal and Ashtaroth.

verses.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.
verses.decoded: The LORD was very angry with Israel, and he handed them over to raiders who plundered them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, so they could no longer resist their enemies.

verses.kjv: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of the LORD was against them for evil, as the LORD had said, and as the LORD had sworn unto them: and they were greatly distressed.
verses.decoded: Wherever they went out, the power of the LORD was against them to bring trouble, just as the LORD had said and as the LORD had promised them; and they were very distressed.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless the LORD raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.
verses.decoded: However, the LORD raised up judges who saved them from the people who were oppressing them.

verses.kjv: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of the LORD; but they did not so.
verses.decoded: And yet they did not listen to their judges, but they went after other gods and worshiped them: they quickly turned away from the path their ancestors followed, obeying the commandments of the LORD; but they did not do that.

verses.kjv: And when the LORD raised them up judges, then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the LORD because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.
verses.decoded: And when the LORD raised up judges for them, the LORD was with the judge and rescued them from the power of their enemies during the entire time the judge led: because the LORD felt sorry for their groaning due to those who oppressed and troubled them.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.
verses.decoded: After the judge died, the people went back and became even more corrupt than their ancestors by following other gods to serve them and to worship them. They did not stop their own actions or their stubborn behavior.

verses.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel; and he said, Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;
verses.decoded: The LORD was very angry with Israel and said, Because these people have broken the covenant I commanded their ancestors to keep, and they have not listened to my voice;

verses.kjv: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died:
verses.decoded: I will also no longer drive out any of the nations that Joshua left when he died from before them.

verses.kjv: That through them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep the way of the LORD to walk therein, as their fathers did keep it, or not.
verses.decoded: That through them I may test Israel to see if they will follow the LORD's way and live by it, just as their ancestors did, or not.

verses.kjv: Therefore the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.
verses.decoded: So the LORD allowed those nations to remain, not forcing them out quickly; and he did not give them into Joshua's control.

verses.kjv: Now these are the nations which the LORD left, to prove Israel by them, even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan;
verses.decoded: Now these are the nations that the LORD left to test Israel through them, especially those Israelites who had not experienced all the wars of Canaan;

verses.kjv: Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof;
verses.decoded: This was so that the generations of the children of Israel would learn how to fight in war, especially those who had never known anything about it before.

verses.kjv: Namely, five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baalhermon unto the entering in of Hamath.
verses.decoded: Specifically, five rulers of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived in Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal-Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.

verses.kjv: And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the LORD, which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.
verses.decoded: They were meant to test Israel through them, to see if they would listen to the commandments of the LORD, which He gave to their ancestors through Moses.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:
verses.decoded: The people of Israel lived among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

verses.kjv: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.
verses.decoded: They married their daughters to their own people and gave their daughters to their sons as wives, and they worshiped their gods.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and forgat the LORD their God, and served Baalim and the groves.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel did evil in the eyes of the LORD, forgot the LORD their God, and worshiped Baalim and the sacred trees.

verses.kjv: Therefore the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Chushanrishathaim eight years.
verses.decoded: So the LORD was very angry with Israel, and he allowed them to be controlled by Chushan-rishathaim, king of Mesopotamia. The people of Israel served Chushan-rishathaim for eight years.

verses.kjv: And when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel, who delivered them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.
verses.decoded: When the people of Israel cried out to the LORD, the LORD raised up a rescuer for the people of Israel, who saved them, Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.

verses.kjv: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he judged Israel, and went out to war: and the LORD delivered Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed against Chushanrishathaim.
verses.decoded: The Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he led Israel as a judge, and went out to fight. The LORD gave Chushan-rishathaim, king of Mesopotamia, into his control, and he was victorious over Chushan-rishathaim.

verses.kjv: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
verses.decoded: The land was peaceful for forty years. Then Othniel, the son of Kenaz, died.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the LORD.
verses.decoded: The Israelites did evil again in the eyes of the LORD, so the LORD made Eglon, the king of Moab, strong against Israel because they had done evil in the eyes of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.
verses.decoded: He gathered the people of Ammon and Amalek to himself, went and attacked Israel, and took control of the city of palm trees.

verses.kjv: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.
verses.decoded: So the people of Israel were under the control of Eglon, the king of Moab, for eighteen years.

verses.kjv: But when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.
verses.decoded: But when the people of Israel cried out to the LORD, the LORD raised up a deliverer for them, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a left-handed man; and through him the people of Israel sent a gift to Eglon, the king of Moab.

verses.kjv: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.
verses.decoded: But Ehud made a dagger for himself that had two sharp edges and was about a cubit long; and he fastened it under his clothing on his right thigh.

verses.kjv: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon was a very fat man.
verses.decoded: He brought the gift to Eglon, king of Moab, and Eglon was a very fat man.

verses.kjv: And when he had made an end to offer the present, he sent away the people that bare the present.
verses.decoded: And after he finished presenting the gift, he sent away the people who had brought the gift.

verses.kjv: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king: who said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.
verses.decoded: But he himself turned back from the quarries near Gilgal and said, I have a secret message for you, O king. The king said, Be quiet. And all who were standing near him left.

verses.kjv: And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting in a summer parlour, which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from God unto thee. And he arose out of his seat.
verses.decoded: And Ehud went to him; and he was sitting in a summer room, which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from God for you. And he got up from his seat.

verses.kjv: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:
verses.decoded: And Ehud extended his left hand, took the dagger from his right thigh, and stabbed it into his stomach:

verses.kjv: And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.
verses.decoded: And the handle also went in after the blade; and the fat closed around the blade, so that he could not pull the dagger out of his stomach; and the dirt came out.

verses.kjv: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked them.
verses.decoded: Then Ehud went out through the entrance, closed the doors of the inner room behind him, and locked them.

verses.kjv: When he was gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that, behold, the doors of the parlour were locked, they said, Surely he covereth his feet in his summer chamber.
verses.decoded: After he had gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that the doors of the room were locked, they said, He must be covering his feet in his summer room.

verses.kjv: And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened them: and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.
verses.decoded: They waited until they were ashamed, and look, he did not open the doors of the room; so they took a key and opened them, and look, their master had fallen down dead on the ground.

verses.kjv: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirath.
verses.decoded: And Ehud escaped while they delayed, and went beyond the quarries, and escaped to Seirath.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim, and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount, and he before them.
verses.decoded: When he arrived, he blew a trumpet on the mountain of Ephraim, and the Israelites went down with him from the mountain, with him leading them.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Follow after me: for the LORD hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and suffered not a man to pass over.
verses.decoded: And he said to them, Follow me, because the LORD has given your enemies, the Moabites, into your hands. So they went down after him, took control of the crossing points of the Jordan River toward Moab, and did not allow anyone to cross.

verses.kjv: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.
verses.decoded: They killed about ten thousand men from Moab at that time, all strong and all brave; not a single man escaped.

verses.kjv: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest fourscore years.
verses.decoded: So Moab was defeated that day by the power of Israel. And the land had peace for eighty years.

verses.kjv: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also delivered Israel.
verses.decoded: After him, Shamgar the son of Anath killed six hundred Philistine men with an ox goad, and he also saved Israel.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the LORD, when Ehud was dead.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel did evil again in the eyes of the LORD after Ehud died.

verses.kjv: And the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host was Sisera, which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.
verses.decoded: The LORD allowed them to be defeated by Jabin, king of Canaan, who ruled in Hazor. The commander of his army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD: for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel cried out to the LORD because he had nine hundred iron chariots and oppressed the people of Israel powerfully for twenty years.

verses.kjv: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.
verses.decoded: Deborah, a prophet and the wife of Lapidoth, was the judge of Israel at that time.

verses.kjv: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.
verses.decoded: She lived under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, and the people of Israel came to her to receive judgment.

verses.kjv: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedeshnaphtali, and said unto him, Hath not the LORD God of Israel commanded, saying, Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?
verses.decoded: She sent for Barak, the son of Abinoam, from Kedesh-naphtali, and said to him, Has not the LORD God of Israel commanded you, saying, Go and march toward Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men from the tribes of Naphtali and Zebulun?

verses.kjv: And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into thine hand.
verses.decoded: And I will bring Sisera, the commander of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his many soldiers, to you at the Kishon River; and I will give him into your hand.

verses.kjv: And Barak said unto her, If thou wilt go with me, then I will go: but if thou wilt not go with me, then I will not go.
verses.decoded: And Barak said to her, If you will go with me, then I will go; but if you will not go with me, then I will not go.

verses.kjv: And she said, I will surely go with thee: notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour; for the LORD shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.
verses.decoded: And she said, I will definitely go with you: however, the journey you are taking will not bring you honor; because the LORD will deliver Sisera into the hands of a woman. Then Deborah got up and went with Barak to Kedesh.

verses.kjv: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.
verses.decoded: And Barak summoned the people of Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men following him; and Deborah went up with him.

verses.kjv: Now Heber the Kenite, which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had severed himself from the Kenites, and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanaim, which is by Kedesh.
verses.decoded: Now Heber the Kenite, who was one of the descendants of Hobab, the father-in-law of Moses, had separated himself from the Kenites and set up his tent in the plain of Zaanaim, which is near Kedesh.

verses.kjv: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor.
verses.decoded: They told Sisera that Barak, the son of Abinoam, had gone up to Mount Tabor.

verses.kjv: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people that were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles unto the river of Kishon.
verses.decoded: And Sisera gathered all his chariots, nine hundred iron chariots, and all the people with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles to the river Kishon.

verses.kjv: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this is the day in which the LORD hath delivered Sisera into thine hand: is not the LORD gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.
verses.decoded: And Deborah said to Barak, Get up; because this is the day the LORD has given Sisera into your hand: has the LORD not gone ahead of you? So Barak went down from Mount Tabor, with ten thousand men following him.

verses.kjv: And the LORD discomfited Sisera, and all his chariots, and all his host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot, and fled away on his feet.
verses.decoded: And the LORD defeated Sisera, and all his chariots, and all his army, with the sword in front of Barak; so Sisera got down from his chariot and ran away on foot.

verses.kjv: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; and there was not a man left.
verses.decoded: But Barak chased after the chariots and the army all the way to Harosheth of the Gentiles, and the entire army of Sisera was killed by the sword; not a single man was left alive.

verses.kjv: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
verses.decoded: However, Sisera ran away on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, because there was peace between Jabin, the king of Hazor, and the family of Heber the Kenite.

verses.kjv: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said unto him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not. And when he had turned in unto her into the tent, she covered him with a mantle.
verses.decoded: And Jael went out to meet Sisera and said to him, "Come in, my lord, come in to me; do not be afraid." And when he came into the tent to her, she covered him with a cloak.

verses.kjv: And he said unto her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him drink, and covered him.
verses.decoded: And he said to her, Please give me a little water to drink because I am thirsty. She opened a container of milk, gave him a drink, and covered him.

verses.kjv: Again he said unto her, Stand in the door of the tent, and it shall be, when any man doth come and enquire of thee, and say, Is there any man here? that thou shalt say, No.
verses.decoded: Again he said to her, Stand at the entrance of the tent, and when any man comes and asks you, saying, Is there any man here? you shall say, No.

verses.kjv: Then Jael Heber’s wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.
verses.decoded: Then Jael, the wife of Heber, took a tent nail and a hammer in her hand, and quietly went to him, and drove the nail into his temple, fixing it into the ground because he was deeply asleep and tired. So he died.

verses.kjv: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said unto him, Come, and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest. And when he came into her tent, behold, Sisera lay dead, and the nail was in his temples.
verses.decoded: And, look, as Barak chased Sisera, Jael came out to meet him and said to him, Come, and I will show you the man you are looking for. When he entered her tent, look, Sisera was lying dead, and the nail was in his temples.

verses.kjv: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: So God defeated Jabin, the king of Canaan, on that day in front of the Israelites.

verses.kjv: And the hand of the children of Israel prospered, and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel succeeded and defeated Jabin, the king of Canaan, until they completely destroyed him.

verses.kjv: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,
verses.decoded: Then Deborah and Barak, the son of Abinoam, sang on that day, saying,

verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD for the avenging of Israel, when the people willingly offered themselves.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD for defending Israel, when the people willingly offered themselves.

verses.kjv: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, even I, will sing unto the LORD; I will sing praise to the LORD God of Israel.
verses.decoded: Listen, you kings; pay attention, you princes; I, yes I, will sing to the LORD; I will sing praise to the LORD God of Israel.

verses.kjv: LORD, when thou wentest out of Seir, when thou marchedst out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, and the heavens dropped, the clouds also dropped water.
verses.decoded: LORD, when you came out of Seir, when you marched out of the field of Edom, the earth shook, and the skies poured down rain, the clouds also poured water.

verses.kjv: The mountains melted from before the LORD, even that Sinai from before the LORD God of Israel.
verses.decoded: The mountains melted away in front of the LORD, even Mount Sinai melted away in front of the LORD God of Israel.

verses.kjv: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, and the travellers walked through byways.
verses.decoded: During the time of Shamgar, the son of Anath, and during the time of Jael, the main roads were deserted, and travelers used side paths.

verses.kjv: The inhabitants of the villages ceased, they ceased in Israel, until that I Deborah arose, that I arose a mother in Israel.
verses.decoded: The people living in the villages stopped working, they stopped in Israel, until I Deborah stood up, I stood up as a mother in Israel.

verses.kjv: They chose new gods; then was war in the gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?
verses.decoded: They chose new gods; then there was fighting at the city gates: was a shield or spear seen among forty thousand people in Israel?

verses.kjv: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, that offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless ye the LORD.
verses.decoded: My heart is with the leaders of Israel, who willingly offered themselves among the people. Praise the LORD.

verses.kjv: Speak, ye that ride on white asses, ye that sit in judgment, and walk by the way.
verses.decoded: Speak, you who ride on white donkeys, you who serve as judges, and you who travel along the road.

verses.kjv: They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water, there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the LORD, even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Israel: then shall the people of the LORD go down to the gates.
verses.decoded: Those who are saved from the sound of archers at the water-drawing places will there tell about the righteous deeds of the LORD, the righteous deeds done for the people living in his villages in Israel. Then the people of the LORD will go down to the city gates.

verses.kjv: Awake, awake, Deborah: awake, awake, utter a song: arise, Barak, and lead thy captivity captive, thou son of Abinoam.
verses.decoded: Wake up, wake up, Deborah; wake up, wake up, sing a song; get up, Barak, and lead your captives away, son of Abinoam.

verses.kjv: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people: the LORD made me have dominion over the mighty.
verses.decoded: Then he made the one who remains have authority over the leaders among the people: the LORD gave me authority over the powerful.

verses.kjv: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek; after thee, Benjamin, among thy people; out of Machir came down governors, and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer.
verses.decoded: From Ephraim came a group against Amalek; after you, Benjamin, among your people; from Machir came leaders, and from Zebulun those who handle the writer's pen.

verses.kjv: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; even Issachar, and also Barak: he was sent on foot into the valley. For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart.
verses.decoded: The leaders of Issachar were with Deborah; both Issachar and Barak were there. Barak was sent on foot into the valley. The people of Reuben had deep and serious plans.

verses.kjv: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds, to hear the bleatings of the flocks? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.
verses.decoded: Why do you stay among the sheepfolds, listening to the bleating of the flocks? Because the tribes of Reuben experienced deep inner reflection.

verses.kjv: Gilead abode beyond Jordan: and why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the sea shore, and abode in his breaches.
verses.decoded: Gilead lived beyond the Jordan River; why did Dan stay on the ships? Asher stayed along the seashore and lived in his coves.

verses.kjv: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field.
verses.decoded: Zebulun and Naphtali were people who risked their lives even to death on the high places in the fields.

verses.kjv: The kings came and fought, then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo; they took no gain of money.
verses.decoded: The kings came and fought, then the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by the waters of Megiddo; they did not gain any money.

verses.kjv: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.
verses.decoded: They fought from heaven; the stars in their paths fought against Sisera.

verses.kjv: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, thou hast trodden down strength.
verses.decoded: The Kishon River swept them away, that ancient river, the Kishon River. Oh my soul, you have crushed strength.

verses.kjv: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings, the pransings of their mighty ones.
verses.decoded: Then the horse hooves were broken because of the galloping, the galloping of their powerful riders.

verses.kjv: Curse ye Meroz, said the angel of the LORD, curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof; because they came not to the help of the LORD, to the help of the LORD against the mighty.
verses.decoded: Curse Meroz, said the angel of the LORD; curse bitterly its inhabitants because they did not come to help the LORD, to help the LORD against the mighty.

verses.kjv: Blessed above women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be, blessed shall she be above women in the tent.
verses.decoded: Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, will be more blessed than other women; she will be more blessed than women who live in tents.

verses.kjv: He asked water, and she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.
verses.decoded: He asked for water, and she gave him milk; she served butter in a noble dish.

verses.kjv: She put her hand to the nail, and her right hand to the workmen’s hammer; and with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote off his head, when she had pierced and stricken through his temples.
verses.decoded: She placed her hand on the nail, and her right hand on the carpenter’s hammer; and with the hammer she struck Sisera, she cut off his head after piercing and striking through his temples.

verses.kjv: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay down: at her feet he bowed, he fell: where he bowed, there he fell down dead.
verses.decoded: He bowed down at her feet, he fell, he lay down: he bowed down at her feet, he fell: where he bowed, there he died.

verses.kjv: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? why tarry the wheels of his chariots?
verses.decoded: The mother of Sisera looked out of a window and shouted through the lattice, Why is his chariot taking so long to come? Why are the wheels of his chariots delayed?

verses.kjv: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,
verses.decoded: Her wise women answered her, yes, she answered herself,

verses.kjv: Have they not sped? have they not divided the prey; to every man a damsel or two; to Sisera a prey of divers colours, a prey of divers colours of needlework, of divers colours of needlework on both sides, meet for the necks of them that take the spoil?
verses.decoded: Have they not succeeded? Have they not divided the captured goods; to every man a young woman or two; to Sisera a prize of many colors, a prize of many colors of embroidery, many colors of embroidery on both sides, suitable for the necks of those who take the spoil?

verses.kjv: So let all thine enemies perish, O LORD: but let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.
verses.decoded: So let all your enemies perish, O LORD; but let those who love him be like the sun when it rises in its strength. And the land had peace for forty years.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel did what was wrong in the eyes of the LORD, so the LORD allowed Midian to control them for seven years.

verses.kjv: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel: and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains, and caves, and strong holds.
verses.decoded: The Midianites defeated Israel, and because of the Midianites, the Israelites made hiding places for themselves in the mountains, caves, and strongholds.

verses.kjv: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east, even they came up against them;
verses.decoded: When Israel had planted their crops, the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the people from the east came up against them.

verses.kjv: And they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till thou come unto Gaza, and left no sustenance for Israel, neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.
verses.decoded: They set up camp against them and destroyed all the crops in the land as far as Gaza, leaving no food for Israel—no sheep, no cattle, and no donkeys.

verses.kjv: For they came up with their cattle and their tents, and they came as grasshoppers for multitude; for both they and their camels were without number: and they entered into the land to destroy it.
verses.decoded: They came with their livestock and their tents, and they were as numerous as grasshoppers; both they and their camels were countless. They entered the land to destroy it.

verses.kjv: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Israel cried unto the LORD.
verses.decoded: Israel became very poor because of the Midianites, and the people of Israel cried out to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD because of the Midianites,
verses.decoded: It happened when the people of Israel cried out to the LORD because of the Midianites,

verses.kjv: That the LORD sent a prophet unto the children of Israel, which said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you forth out of the house of bondage;
verses.decoded: The LORD sent a prophet to the children of Israel, who said to them, 'This is what the LORD God of Israel says: I brought you up from Egypt and led you out of slavery;'

verses.kjv: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all that oppressed you, and drave them out from before you, and gave you their land;
verses.decoded: And I rescued you from the power of the Egyptians, and from the power of everyone who oppressed you, and I forced them to leave in front of you, and I gave you their land;

verses.kjv: And I said unto you, I am the LORD your God; fear not the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but ye have not obeyed my voice.
verses.decoded: And I said to you, I am the LORD your God; do not be afraid of the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you live: but you have not obeyed my voice.

verses.kjv: And there came an angel of the LORD, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abiezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.
verses.decoded: An angel of the LORD came and sat under an oak tree in Ophrah, which belonged to Joash the Abi-ezrite. His son Gideon was threshing wheat near the winepress to keep it hidden from the Midianites.

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.
verses.decoded: And the angel of the LORD appeared to him and said to him, The LORD is with you, you mighty man of courage.

verses.kjv: And Gideon said unto him, Oh my Lord, if the LORD be with us, why then is all this befallen us? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not the LORD bring us up from Egypt? but now the LORD hath forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.
verses.decoded: And Gideon said to him, My Lord, if the LORD is with us, why has all this happened to us? And where are all his miracles that our ancestors told us about, saying, Did not the LORD bring us up from Egypt? But now the LORD has abandoned us and handed us over to the Midianites.

verses.kjv: And the LORD looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy might, and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent thee?
verses.decoded: The LORD looked at him and said, Go with your strength, and you will save Israel from the Midianites' control. Did I not send you?

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family is poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father’s house.
verses.decoded: And he said to him, My Lord, how can I save Israel? Look, my family is poor in Manasseh, and I am the least important in my father's house.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to him, Surely I will be with you, and you will defeat the Midianites as if you were one man.

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, then shew me a sign that thou talkest with me.
verses.decoded: And he said to him, If I have found favor in your eyes, then show me a sign that you are speaking with me.

verses.kjv: Depart not hence, I pray thee, until I come unto thee, and bring forth my present, and set it before thee. And he said, I will tarry until thou come again.
verses.decoded: Please do not leave until I come to you and bring my gift and place it in front of you. And he said, I will wait until you come back.

verses.kjv: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out unto him under the oak, and presented it.
verses.decoded: And Gideon went inside, prepared a young goat, and made unleavened bread from an ephah of flour; he put the meat in a basket, placed the broth in a pot, brought them out to him under the oak, and gave it to him.

verses.kjv: And the angel of God said unto him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay them upon this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.
verses.decoded: And the angel of God said to him, Take the meat and the unleavened cakes, and place them on this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did it.

verses.kjv: Then the angel of the LORD put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the LORD departed out of his sight.
verses.decoded: Then the angel of the LORD stretched out the end of the staff that was in his hand and touched the meat and the unleavened cakes; fire came up from the rock and burned the meat and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the LORD left from his sight.

verses.kjv: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the LORD, Gideon said, Alas, O LORD God! for because I have seen an angel of the LORD face to face.
verses.decoded: When Gideon realized that he was an angel of the LORD, Gideon said, "Oh no, Lord GOD! I have seen an angel of the LORD face to face."

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to him, Peace be with you; do not be afraid: you will not die.

verses.kjv: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the LORD, and called it Jehovahshalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.decoded: Then Gideon built an altar there to the LORD, and named it Jehovah-shalom; it is still there today in Ophrah of the Abi-ezrites.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Take thy father’s young bullock, even the second bullock of seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath, and cut down the grove that is by it:
verses.decoded: That same night, the LORD said to him, 'Take your father's young bull, the second bull that is seven years old, and tear down the altar of Baal that your father has, and cut down the sacred tree beside it.'

verses.kjv: And build an altar unto the LORD thy God upon the top of this rock, in the ordered place, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down.
verses.decoded: And build an altar to the LORD your God on top of this rock, in the designated place, and take the second bull, and offer a burnt sacrifice using the wood from the tree you will cut down.

verses.kjv: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the LORD had said unto him: and so it was, because he feared his father’s household, and the men of the city, that he could not do it by day, that he did it by night.
verses.decoded: Then Gideon took ten of his servants and did as the LORD had told him. Because he was afraid of his father's household and the men of the city, he could not do it during the day, so he did it at night.

verses.kjv: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was cast down, and the grove was cut down that was by it, and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built.
verses.decoded: When the men of the city got up early in the morning, they saw that the altar of Baal had been knocked down, the tree beside it had been cut down, and the second young bull was offered on the altar that had been built.

verses.kjv: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing? And when they enquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.
verses.decoded: And they said to each other, Who has done this thing? When they investigated and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash has done this thing.

verses.kjv: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out thy son, that he may die: because he hath cast down the altar of Baal, and because he hath cut down the grove that was by it.
verses.decoded: Then the men of the city said to Joash, Bring out your son so that he may die, because he has knocked down the altar of Baal and because he has cut down the sacred tree beside it.

verses.kjv: And Joash said unto all that stood against him, Will ye plead for Baal? will ye save him? he that will plead for him, let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning: if he be a god, let him plead for himself, because one hath cast down his altar.
verses.decoded: And Joash said to all who were opposing him, Are you going to defend Baal? Are you going to save him? Whoever defends him, let that person be put to death this very morning. If he is a god, let him defend himself, since someone has destroyed his altar.

verses.kjv: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal plead against him, because he hath thrown down his altar.
verses.decoded: Therefore on that day he named him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal defend himself against him, because he has destroyed his altar.

verses.kjv: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east were gathered together, and went over, and pitched in the valley of Jezreel.
verses.decoded: Then all the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the people from the east gathered together, crossed over, and camped in the valley of Jezreel.

verses.kjv: But the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered after him.
verses.decoded: But the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and the men of Abi-ezer gathered behind him.

verses.kjv: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; who also was gathered after him: and he sent messengers unto Asher, and unto Zebulun, and unto Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.
verses.decoded: He sent messengers throughout all Manasseh, and they gathered behind him; he also sent messengers to Asher, Zebulun, and Naphtali, and they came up to meet them.

verses.kjv: And Gideon said unto God, If thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said,
verses.decoded: And Gideon said to God, If you will save Israel by my hand, as you have said,

verses.kjv: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.
verses.decoded: Look, I will place a fleece of wool on the ground; and if the dew is only on the fleece, and the rest of the ground is dry, then I will know that you will save Israel by my hand, as you have said.

verses.kjv: And it was so: for he rose up early on the morrow, and thrust the fleece together, and wringed the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.
verses.decoded: And it happened as he said: he got up early the next morning, squeezed the fleece together, and wrung the dew out of the fleece, filling a bowl with water.

verses.kjv: And Gideon said unto God, Let not thine anger be hot against me, and I will speak but this once: let me prove, I pray thee, but this once with the fleece; let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.
verses.decoded: And Gideon said to God, Do not be angry with me, and I will say this only once: please let me test this only once with the fleece; let the fleece alone be dry now, and let there be dew on all the ground.

verses.kjv: And God did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.
verses.decoded: And God did this that night: the fleece alone was dry, and there was dew on the entire ground.

verses.kjv: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people that were with him, rose up early, and pitched beside the well of Harod: so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.
verses.decoded: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people with him, got up early and camped beside the well of Harod. The army of the Midianites was on the north side of them, near the hill of Moreh, in the valley.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people that are with thee are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel vaunt themselves against me, saying, Mine own hand hath saved me.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Gideon, The people with you are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, because Israel might boast against me, saying, My own strength saved me.

verses.kjv: Now therefore go to, proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, Whosoever is fearful and afraid, let him return and depart early from mount Gilead. And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand; and there remained ten thousand.
verses.decoded: Now, go and announce to the people, saying, Whoever is fearful and afraid, let him return and leave early from Mount Gilead. And twenty-two thousand of the people returned; and ten thousand remained.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people are yet too many; bring them down unto the water, and I will try them for thee there: and it shall be, that of whom I say unto thee, This shall go with thee, the same shall go with thee; and of whomsoever I say unto thee, This shall not go with thee, the same shall not go.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Gideon, The people are still too many; bring them down to the water, and I will test them for you there: and it will be that whoever I say to you, This one shall go with you, that one shall go with you; and whoever I say to you, This one shall not go with you, that one shall not go.

verses.kjv: So he brought down the people unto the water: and the LORD said unto Gideon, Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue, as a dog lappeth, him shalt thou set by himself; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink.
verses.decoded: So he brought the people down to the water, and the LORD said to Gideon, "Everyone who drinks water by licking it with his tongue, like a dog licks, you shall set apart by himself; and everyone who kneels down to drink, you shall also set apart."

verses.kjv: And the number of them that lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.
verses.decoded: The number of men who drank by putting their hand to their mouth was three hundred, but all the other people knelt down to drink water.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thine hand: and let all the other people go every man unto his place.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Gideon, I will save you by the three hundred men who drank water by lapping, and I will deliver the Midianites into your hand; and let all the other people return each to his own place.

verses.kjv: So the people took victuals in their hand, and their trumpets: and he sent all the rest of Israel every man unto his tent, and retained those three hundred men: and the host of Midian was beneath him in the valley.
verses.decoded: So the people took food in their hands and their trumpets; and he sent all the rest of Israel, each man, back to his tent, and kept those three hundred men; and the army of Midian was below him in the valley.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Arise, get thee down unto the host; for I have delivered it into thine hand.
verses.decoded: That same night, the LORD said to him, 'Get up and go down to the army, because I have given it into your hand.'

verses.kjv: But if thou fear to go down, go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host:
verses.decoded: But if you are afraid to go down, go down with Phurah your servant to the army:

verses.kjv: And thou shalt hear what they say; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host. Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host.
verses.decoded: And you will hear what they say; and afterward your hands will be strengthened to go down to the army. Then he went down with Phurah his servant to the edge of the armed men who were in the army.

verses.kjv: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand by the sea side for multitude.
verses.decoded: The Midianites, the Amalekites, and all the people from the east were lying in the valley like grasshoppers because there were so many of them; and their camels were countless, as numerous as the sand on the seashore.

verses.kjv: And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.
verses.decoded: When Gideon arrived, there was a man who told a dream to his companion and said, "I dreamed a dream, and a cake of barley bread rolled into the Midian army, reached a tent, struck it so that it fell and overturned, and the tent lay flat."

verses.kjv: And his fellow answered and said, This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel: for into his hand hath God delivered Midian, and all the host.
verses.decoded: And his companion answered and said, This is nothing else but the sword of Gideon, the son of Joash, a man of Israel: because God has delivered Midian and all their army into his hand.

verses.kjv: And it was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the interpretation thereof, that he worshipped, and returned into the host of Israel, and said, Arise; for the LORD hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian.
verses.decoded: And it happened that when Gideon heard the dream and its interpretation, he worshiped and returned to the army of Israel and said, Get up; because the LORD has given the army of Midian into your hands.

verses.kjv: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put a trumpet in every man’s hand, with empty pitchers, and lamps within the pitchers.
verses.decoded: He divided the three hundred men into three groups, and he put a trumpet in each man's hand, along with empty pitchers, and lamps inside the pitchers.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Look on me, and do likewise: and, behold, when I come to the outside of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so shall ye do.
verses.decoded: And he said to them, Watch me and do the same: and when I come to the edge of the camp, you will do exactly as I do.

verses.kjv: When I blow with a trumpet, I and all that are with me, then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and say, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.
verses.decoded: When I blow the trumpet, I and everyone with me will blow the trumpets too on every side of the entire camp, and say, 'The sword of the LORD and of Gideon.'

verses.kjv: So Gideon, and the hundred men that were with him, came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch; and they had but newly set the watch: and they blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers that were in their hands.
verses.decoded: So Gideon and the hundred men with him came to the edge of the camp at the start of the middle watch; the guards had just been posted. They blew the trumpets and broke the jars they were holding.

verses.kjv: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.
verses.decoded: And the three groups blew the trumpets, broke the pitchers, held the lamps in their left hands, and held the trumpets in their right hands to blow them; and they shouted, 'The sword of the LORD and of Gideon!'

verses.kjv: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp; and all the host ran, and cried, and fled.
verses.decoded: And each man stood in his position all around the camp, and the entire army ran, shouted, and fled.

verses.kjv: And the three hundred blew the trumpets, and the LORD set every man’s sword against his fellow, even throughout all the host: and the host fled to Bethshittah in Zererath, and to the border of Abelmeholah, unto Tabbath.
verses.decoded: And the three hundred blew the trumpets, and the LORD caused each man's sword to turn against his companion throughout the entire army; and the army fled to Beth-shittah in Zererath, and to the border of Abel-meholah, up to Tabbath.

verses.kjv: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after the Midianites.
verses.decoded: The men of Israel gathered from Naphtali, Asher, and all of Manasseh and chased after the Midianites.

verses.kjv: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying, Come down against the Midianites, and take before them the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and took the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan.
verses.decoded: Gideon sent messengers throughout all of Mount Ephraim, saying, 'Come down against the Midianites and seize the water sources before them at Beth-barah and the Jordan.' Then all the men of Ephraim gathered together and seized the water sources at Beth-barah and the Jordan.

verses.kjv: And they took two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb, and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb, and pursued Midian, and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan.
verses.decoded: They captured two leaders of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb; they killed Oreb at the rock called Oreb, and they killed Zeeb at the winepress called Zeeb. Then they chased the Midianites and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side of the Jordan River.

verses.kjv: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.
verses.decoded: And the men of Ephraim said to him, Why have you treated us like this by not calling us when you went to fight the Midianites? And they argued with him angrily.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?
verses.decoded: And he said to them, What have I done now compared to you? Is not the gathering of the leftover grapes of Ephraim better than the full grape harvest of Abi-ezer?

verses.kjv: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.
verses.decoded: God has delivered into your hands the leaders of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. What was I able to do compared to you? Then their anger toward him was reduced when he said that.

verses.kjv: And Gideon came to Jordan, and passed over, he, and the three hundred men that were with him, faint, yet pursuing them.
verses.decoded: And Gideon came to the Jordan River and crossed over, he and the three hundred men who were with him, tired but still chasing them.

verses.kjv: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they be faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.
verses.decoded: And he said to the men of Succoth, Please give loaves of bread to the people who are following me, because they are tired, and I am chasing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.

verses.kjv: And the princes of Succoth said, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?
verses.decoded: And the leaders of Succoth said, Are Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hands, that we should give bread to your army?

verses.kjv: And Gideon said, Therefore when the LORD hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.
verses.decoded: And Gideon said, Therefore when the LORD has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.

verses.kjv: And he went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them likewise: and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered him.
verses.decoded: And he went up from there to Penuel, and spoke to them in the same way: and the men of Penuel answered him just as the men of Succoth had answered him.

verses.kjv: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.
verses.decoded: And he also spoke to the men of Penuel, saying, When I return in peace, I will tear down this tower.

verses.kjv: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand men, all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east: for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.
verses.decoded: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their armies were with them, about fifteen thousand men, all that remained of all the armies of the people of the east: because one hundred and twenty thousand men who fought with swords had died.

verses.kjv: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host: for the host was secure.
verses.decoded: And Gideon went up by the route of those who lived in tents east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and attacked the army because the army was confident and unprepared.

verses.kjv: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.
verses.decoded: When Zebah and Zalmunna ran away, he chased after them, captured the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and defeated their entire army.

verses.kjv: And Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle before the sun was up,
verses.decoded: And Gideon, the son of Joash, came back from the battle before the sun had risen,

verses.kjv: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and enquired of him: and he described unto him the princes of Succoth, and the elders thereof, even threescore and seventeen men.
verses.decoded: And they caught a young man from the men of Succoth and asked him questions; he told them about the leaders of Succoth and its elders, a total of seventy-seven men.

verses.kjv: And he came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom ye did upbraid me, saying, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary?
verses.decoded: And he went to the men of Succoth and said, Look, Zebah and Zalmunna, the ones you criticized me about, are now in your hands. Should we give bread to your tired men?

verses.kjv: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
verses.decoded: He took the leaders of the city, along with thorns and briers from the wilderness, and used them to teach the men of Succoth.

verses.kjv: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.
verses.decoded: He destroyed the tower of Penuel and killed the men of the city.

verses.kjv: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou art, so were they; each one resembled the children of a king.
verses.decoded: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, What kind of men were the ones you killed at Tabor? And they answered, They were like you; each one looked like the sons of a king.

verses.kjv: And he said, They were my brethren, even the sons of my mother: as the LORD liveth, if ye had saved them alive, I would not slay you.
verses.decoded: And he said, They were my brothers, the sons of my mother: as the LORD lives, if you had kept them alive, I would not kill you.

verses.kjv: And he said unto Jether his firstborn, Up, and slay them. But the youth drew not his sword: for he feared, because he was yet a youth.
verses.decoded: And he said to Jether his firstborn, Get up and kill them. But the young man did not draw his sword because he was afraid, since he was still young.

verses.kjv: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise thou, and fall upon us: for as the man is, so is his strength. And Gideon arose, and slew Zebah and Zalmunna, and took away the ornaments that were on their camels’ necks.
verses.decoded: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Get up and attack us, because a man's strength matches who he is. So Gideon got up, killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and took the ornaments that were on their camels' necks.

verses.kjv: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon, Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son also: for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian.
verses.decoded: Then the men of Israel said to Gideon, Rule over us, you, your son, and your grandson also, because you have saved us from the hand of Midian.

verses.kjv: And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: the LORD shall rule over you.
verses.decoded: And Gideon said to them, I will not rule over you, nor will my son rule over you; the LORD will rule over you.

verses.kjv: And Gideon said unto them, I would desire a request of you, that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey. (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)
verses.decoded: And Gideon said to them, I would like to ask you to give me the earrings that each man took from his enemy. (Because they had golden earrings, since they were Ishmaelites.)

verses.kjv: And they answered, We will willingly give them. And they spread a garment, and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey.
verses.decoded: And they answered, We will gladly give them. Then they spread out a garment, and each man threw into it the earrings taken from his enemy.

verses.kjv: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold; beside ornaments, and collars, and purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian, and beside the chains that were about their camels’ necks.
verses.decoded: The weight of the gold earrings he asked for was one thousand seven hundred shekels of gold, in addition to ornaments, collars, and purple clothing that belonged to the kings of Midian, and also the chains that were around their camels’ necks.

verses.kjv: And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, even in Ophrah: and all Israel went thither a whoring after it: which thing became a snare unto Gideon, and to his house.
