verses.decoded: And Gideon made an ephod from it and placed it in his city, in Ophrah. All Israel went there and began to worship it improperly, which became a trap for Gideon and his family.

verses.kjv: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel, so that they lifted up their heads no more. And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon.
verses.decoded: This is how Midian was defeated by the people of Israel, so they never rose up again. The land was peaceful for forty years during the time of Gideon.

verses.kjv: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.
verses.decoded: Jerubbaal, the son of Joash, went and lived in his own house.

verses.kjv: And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten: for he had many wives.
verses.decoded: And Gideon had seventy sons born to him because he had many wives.

verses.kjv: And his concubine that was in Shechem, she also bare him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.
verses.decoded: And his concubine who was in Shechem also gave birth to a son, and he named him Abimelech.

verses.kjv: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.decoded: Gideon, the son of Joash, died at a good old age, and was buried in the tomb of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abi-ezrites.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the children of Israel turned again, and went a whoring after Baalim, and made Baalberith their god.
verses.decoded: After Gideon died, the people of Israel turned back and started worshiping the Baals, and they made Baal-berith their god.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel remembered not the LORD their God, who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side:
verses.decoded: The people of Israel did not remember the LORD their God, who had saved them from the hands of all their enemies around them.

verses.kjv: Neither shewed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, namely, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shewed unto Israel.
verses.decoded: They did not show kindness to the family of Jerubbaal, that is, Gideon, in proportion to all the good he had done for Israel.

verses.kjv: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother’s brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother’s father, saying,
verses.decoded: And Abimelech, the son of Jerubbaal, went to Shechem to his mother's brothers, and talked with them, and with all the family of his mother's father's household, saying,

verses.kjv: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether is better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, which are threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.
verses.decoded: Please speak to all the men of Shechem and ask them, Which is better for you: that all the seventy sons of Jerubbaal rule over you, or that one man rules over you? Also remember that I am your own kin.

verses.kjv: And his mother’s brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He is our brother.
verses.decoded: And his mother's brothers spoke about him to all the men of Shechem, saying all these things: and their hearts were inclined to follow Abimelech because they said, He is our brother.

verses.kjv: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baalberith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons, which followed him.
verses.decoded: They gave him seventy pieces of silver from the house of Baal-berith, with which Abimelech hired worthless and unreliable men who followed him.

verses.kjv: And he went unto his father’s house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone: notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself.
verses.decoded: And he went to his father’s house at Ophrah, and killed his brothers, the sons of Jerubbaal, seventy men in total, on one stone; however, Jotham, the youngest son of Jerubbaal, was still alive because he hid himself.

verses.kjv: And all the men of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of Millo, and went, and made Abimelech king, by the plain of the pillar that was in Shechem.
verses.decoded: All the men of Shechem gathered together, along with the entire family of Millo, and they went and made Abimelech king near the plain of the pillar in Shechem.

verses.kjv: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken unto you.
verses.decoded: When they told Jotham, he went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim, raised his voice, shouted, and said to them, Listen to me, men of Shechem, so that God may listen to you.

verses.kjv: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive tree, Reign thou over us.
verses.decoded: The trees once went out to choose a king over themselves; and they said to the olive tree, Rule over us.

verses.kjv: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me they honour God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.decoded: But the olive tree said to them, Should I leave my richness, through which people honor God and humans because of me, and go to be placed above the other trees?

verses.kjv: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.decoded: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come and rule over us.

verses.kjv: But the fig tree said unto them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.decoded: But the fig tree said to them, Should I give up my sweetness and my good fruit to become ruler over the trees?

verses.kjv: Then said the trees unto the vine, Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.decoded: Then the trees said to the vine, Come and rule over us.

verses.kjv: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.decoded: And the vine said to them, Should I stop producing my wine, which makes God and people happy, and go to be in charge of the trees?

verses.kjv: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.decoded: Then all the trees said to the bramble, 'Come and rule over us.'

verses.kjv: And the bramble said unto the trees, If in truth ye anoint me king over you, then come and put your trust in my shadow: and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.decoded: And the bramble said to the trees, If you really choose me as your king, then come and take shelter in my shade; but if not, let fire come out of the bramble and burn up the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, if ye have done truly and sincerely, in that ye have made Abimelech king, and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands;
verses.decoded: Now therefore, if you have acted honestly and sincerely by making Abimelech king, and if you have treated Jerubbaal and his family well, and have repaid him according to what his actions deserve;

verses.kjv: (For my father fought for you, and adventured his life far, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian:
verses.decoded: (Because my father fought for you, risked his life greatly, and saved you from the hand of Midian:

verses.kjv: And ye are risen up against my father’s house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother;)
verses.decoded: And you have risen up against my father’s family today, and have killed his seventy sons on one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother.

verses.kjv: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:
verses.decoded: If you have acted honestly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and his family today, then be happy with Abimelech, and let him be happy with you as well.

verses.kjv: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.
verses.decoded: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and consume the men of Shechem and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem and from the house of Millo and consume Abimelech.

verses.kjv: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
verses.decoded: Jotham ran away, escaped, and went to Beer, and lived there because he was afraid of his brother Abimelech.

verses.kjv: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel,
verses.decoded: After Abimelech had ruled over Israel for three years,

verses.kjv: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech:
verses.decoded: Then God sent an evil spirit to cause conflict between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem acted deceitfully toward Abimelech.

verses.kjv: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, which aided him in the killing of his brethren.
verses.decoded: So that the cruelty done to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal would be punished, and their blood would be held against Abimelech their brother, who killed them; and against the men of Shechem, who helped him kill his brothers.

verses.kjv: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech.
verses.decoded: The men of Shechem placed ambushers on the mountain tops, and they robbed everyone who passed by that way; and Abimelech was informed about it.

verses.kjv: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.
verses.decoded: And Gaal, the son of Ebed, came with his brothers and went to Shechem, and the men of Shechem trusted him.

verses.kjv: And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards, and trode the grapes, and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.
verses.decoded: They went out into the fields, gathered their grapes from the vineyards, pressed the grapes, celebrated, went into the house of their god, ate and drank, and cursed Abimelech.

verses.kjv: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? is not he the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him?
verses.decoded: And Gaal, the son of Ebed, said, Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? Isn't he the son of Jerubbaal? And isn't Zebul his officer? Serve the men of Hamor, the father of Shechem. Why should we serve him?

verses.kjv: And would to God this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase thine army, and come out.
verses.decoded: I wish to God this people were under my control! Then I would remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase your army, and come out.

verses.kjv: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.
verses.decoded: When Zebul, the ruler of the city, heard what Gaal, the son of Ebed, said, he became very angry.

verses.kjv: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem; and, behold, they fortify the city against thee.
verses.decoded: And he sent messengers secretly to Abimelech, saying, Look, Gaal the son of Ebed and his relatives have come to Shechem; and look, they are strengthening the city against you.

verses.kjv: Now therefore up by night, thou and the people that is with thee, and lie in wait in the field:
verses.decoded: So get up at night, you and the people with you, and lie in wait in the field.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, thou shalt rise early, and set upon the city: and, behold, when he and the people that is with him come out against thee, then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion.
verses.decoded: And it will happen that in the morning, as soon as the sun rises, you will get up early and attack the city; and when he and the people with him come out against you, then you may do to them whatever opportunity you find.

verses.kjv: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.
verses.decoded: And Abimelech got up, and all the people who were with him, during the night, and they waited in ambush against Shechem in four groups.

verses.kjv: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and Abimelech rose up, and the people that were with him, from lying in wait.
verses.decoded: Gaal, the son of Ebed, went outside and stood at the entrance of the city gate. Abimelech got up, along with the people who were with him, from their hiding place.

verses.kjv: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, there come people down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said unto him, Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men.
verses.decoded: When Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Look, people are coming down from the top of the mountains. But Zebul said to him, You are seeing the shadows of the mountains as if they were men.

verses.kjv: And Gaal spake again and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.
verses.decoded: And Gaal spoke again and said, Look, people are coming down through the middle of the land, and another group is coming along the plain of Meonenim.

verses.kjv: Then said Zebul unto him, Where is now thy mouth, wherewith thou saidst, Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? is not this the people that thou hast despised? go out, I pray now, and fight with them.
verses.decoded: Then Zebul said to him, Where is your mouth now, with which you said, Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? Is this not the people you have despised? Please go out now and fight with them.

verses.kjv: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
verses.decoded: And Gaal went out in front of the men of Shechem and fought against Abimelech.

verses.kjv: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown and wounded, even unto the entering of the gate.
verses.decoded: And Abimelech chased him, and he ran away from him, and many people were knocked down and injured, all the way to the entrance of the gate.

verses.kjv: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.
verses.decoded: And Abimelech lived in Arumah, and Zebul forced Gaal and his relatives to leave so that they would not live in Shechem.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.
verses.decoded: The next day, the people went out into the field and told Abimelech.

verses.kjv: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field, and looked, and, behold, the people were come forth out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.
verses.decoded: And he took the people and divided them into three groups, and waited in the field, and watched, and saw that the people had come out of the city; and he stood up against them and struck them down.

verses.kjv: And Abimelech, and the company that was with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields, and slew them.
verses.decoded: Abimelech and the group with him rushed forward and stood at the entrance of the city gate, while the other two groups ran against all the people who were in the fields and killed them.

verses.kjv: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.
verses.decoded: And Abimelech fought against the city all day; he captured the city, killed the people inside, destroyed the city, and scattered salt over it.

verses.kjv: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that, they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith.
verses.decoded: When all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that, they went into a stronghold in the house of the god Berith.

verses.kjv: And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
verses.decoded: Abimelech was informed that all the men of the tower of Shechem had gathered together.

verses.kjv: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid it on his shoulder, and said unto the people that were with him, What ye have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done.
verses.decoded: And Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, he and all the people who were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, cut down a branch from the trees, took it, laid it on his shoulder, and said to the people who were with him, "What you have seen me do, hurry and do the same."

verses.kjv: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put them to the hold, and set the hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.
verses.decoded: And all the people also cut down branches from their own trees, followed Abimelech, entered the stronghold, and set it on fire against them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died, about a thousand men and women.

verses.kjv: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.
verses.decoded: Then Abimelech went to Thebez, set up camp against Thebez, and captured it.

verses.kjv: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut it to them, and gat them up to the top of the tower.
verses.decoded: But there was a strong tower inside the city, and all the men and women, and everyone in the city, fled there, closed the door behind them, and climbed up to the top of the tower.

verses.kjv: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
verses.decoded: And Abimelech came to the tower, fought against it, and went strongly to the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

verses.kjv: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech’s head, and all to brake his skull.
verses.decoded: And a certain woman threw a piece of a millstone onto Abimelech’s head, and it broke his skull completely.

verses.kjv: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer, and said unto him, Draw thy sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A woman slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.
verses.decoded: Then he quickly called to the young man who carried his armor and said to him, 'Draw your sword and kill me, so that people will not say about me, "A woman killed him." ' And the young man stabbed him, and he died.

verses.kjv: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.
verses.decoded: When the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, each one went back to his own home.

verses.kjv: Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:
verses.decoded: So God gave Abimelech the punishment for the evil he did to his father by killing his seventy brothers.

verses.kjv: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.
verses.decoded: And God caused all the evil that the men of Shechem did to come back upon them: and the curse of Jotham, the son of Jerubbaal, came upon them.

verses.kjv: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.
verses.decoded: After Abimelech, Tola, the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man from the tribe of Issachar, rose to lead Israel. He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.

verses.kjv: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
verses.decoded: He led Israel as judge for twenty-three years, then he died and was buried in Shamir.

verses.kjv: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.
verses.decoded: After him, Jair, a man from Gilead, became a leader and led Israel for twenty-two years.

verses.kjv: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havothjair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
verses.decoded: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty young donkeys, and they owned thirty cities, which are still called Havoth-jair today, located in the land of Gilead.

verses.kjv: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.
verses.decoded: Jair died and was buried in Camon.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the LORD, and served not him.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel did evil again in the eyes of the LORD, and they worshiped Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the people of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and they abandoned the LORD and did not serve him.

verses.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.
verses.decoded: The LORD was very angry with Israel, and he allowed them to be captured by the Philistines and the people of Ammon.

verses.kjv: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel: eighteen years, all the children of Israel that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.
verses.decoded: And during that year, they troubled and oppressed the people of Israel for eighteen years, all the Israelites living on the other side of the Jordan River in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.

verses.kjv: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.
verses.decoded: Also, the people of Ammon crossed the Jordan River to fight against Judah, Benjamin, and the tribe of Ephraim, causing Israel to be greatly troubled.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.
verses.decoded: The children of Israel cried out to the LORD, saying, We have sinned against you because we have abandoned our God and also served Baalim.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to the children of Israel, Did I not rescue you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the people of Ammon, and from the Philistines?

verses.kjv: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.
verses.decoded: The Zidonians, the Amalekites, and the Maonites also oppressed you; and you cried out to me, and I rescued you from their control.

verses.kjv: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.
verses.decoded: Yet you have abandoned me and worshiped other gods; therefore, I will no longer save you.

verses.kjv: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.
verses.decoded: Go and call out to the gods that you have chosen; let them save you during your time of trouble.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel said unto the LORD, We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.
verses.decoded: And the children of Israel said to the LORD, We have sinned: do to us whatever seems good to you; only save us, we pray, today.

verses.kjv: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
verses.decoded: They removed the foreign gods from among them and served the LORD; and He was deeply troubled by the suffering of Israel.

verses.kjv: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.
verses.decoded: Then the people of Ammon gathered together and camped in Gilead. And the people of Israel gathered together and camped in Mizpeh.

verses.kjv: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
verses.decoded: The people and leaders of Gilead said to each other, Who will be the man to start fighting against the children of Ammon? He will be the leader over all the people of Gilead.

verses.kjv: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.
verses.decoded: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a brave and strong man, and he was the son of a prostitute; Gilead was his father.

verses.kjv: And Gilead’s wife bare him sons; and his wife’s sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father’s house; for thou art the son of a strange woman.
verses.decoded: Gilead’s wife gave birth to sons; and his wife’s sons grew up, and they forced Jephthah out, and said to him, You will not inherit in our father’s house because you are the son of a different woman.

verses.kjv: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.
verses.decoded: Then Jephthah ran away from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob. Some worthless men joined Jephthah and went out with him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.
verses.decoded: After some time had passed, the people of Ammon made war against Israel.

verses.kjv: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:
verses.decoded: It happened that when the people of Ammon made war against Israel, the leaders of Gilead went to bring Jephthah from the land of Tob.

verses.kjv: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.
verses.decoded: And they said to Jephthah, Come and be our leader, so that we can fight against the people of Ammon.

verses.kjv: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not ye hate me, and expel me out of my father’s house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?
verses.decoded: And Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, Didn’t you hate me and force me out of my father’s house? So why have you come to me now that you are in trouble?

verses.kjv: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
verses.decoded: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, Therefore we are turning to you now, so that you may go with us and fight against the people of Ammon, and be our leader over all the people of Gilead.

verses.kjv: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the LORD deliver them before me, shall I be your head?
verses.decoded: And Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, If you bring me back to fight against the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivers them into my hands, will I be your leader?

verses.kjv: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The LORD be witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.
verses.decoded: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, The LORD is witness between us if we do not do as you say.

verses.kjv: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before the LORD in Mizpeh.
verses.decoded: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him their leader and commander; and Jephthah spoke all his words before the LORD at Mizpeh.

verses.kjv: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come against me to fight in my land?
verses.decoded: And Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What do you have against me that you have come to fight against me in my land?

verses.kjv: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore restore those lands again peaceably.
verses.decoded: The king of the Ammonites answered the messengers of Jephthah, "Because Israel took my land when they came up from Egypt, from the Arnon River to the Jabbok River and to the Jordan River, now return those lands peacefully."

verses.kjv: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon:
verses.decoded: And Jephthah sent messengers again to the king of the children of Ammon:

verses.kjv: And said unto him, Thus saith Jephthah, Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:
verses.decoded: And said to him, This is what Jephthah says: Israel did not take away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:

verses.kjv: But when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;
verses.decoded: But when Israel left Egypt and traveled through the wilderness to the Red Sea, and arrived at Kadesh;

verses.kjv: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land: but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto. And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not consent: and Israel abode in Kadesh.
verses.decoded: Then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, Please let me pass through your land; but the king of Edom did not listen to them. Similarly, they sent to the king of Moab, but he did not agree; so Israel stayed in Kadesh.

verses.kjv: Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon was the border of Moab.
verses.decoded: Then they traveled through the wilderness, went around the land of Edom and the land of Moab, and came to the east side of the land of Moab, and camped on the other side of the Arnon River, but did not enter the territory of Moab, because the Arnon River was the border of Moab.

verses.kjv: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land into my place.
verses.decoded: Israel sent messengers to Sihon, king of the Amorites and king of Heshbon; and Israel said to him, Please let us pass through your land into our territory.

verses.kjv: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
verses.decoded: But Sihon did not allow Israel to pass through his territory; instead, Sihon gathered all his people, camped at Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

verses.kjv: And the LORD God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.
verses.decoded: The LORD God of Israel gave Sihon and all his people into the control of Israel, and they defeated them; so Israel took possession of all the land of the Amorites, who lived in that region.

verses.kjv: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.
verses.decoded: And they controlled all the lands of the Amorites, from the Arnon River all the way to the Jabbok River, and from the wilderness all the way to the Jordan River.

verses.kjv: So now the LORD God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and shouldest thou possess it?
verses.decoded: So now the LORD God of Israel has driven out the Amorites from in front of his people Israel, and should you take possession of it?

verses.kjv: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess? So whomsoever the LORD our God shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.
verses.decoded: Will you not take possession of what Chemosh your god gives you to possess? So whoever the LORD our God drives out from before us, we will take possession of them.

verses.kjv: And now art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them,
verses.decoded: And now are you any better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever oppose Israel, or did he ever fight against them?

verses.kjv: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that be along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did ye not recover them within that time?
verses.decoded: While Israel lived in Heshbon and its towns, and in Aroer and its towns, and in all the cities along the banks of the Arnon River for three hundred years, why then did you not take them back during that time?

verses.kjv: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee, but thou doest me wrong to war against me: the LORD the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.
verses.decoded: Therefore I have not sinned against you, but you are wronging me by making war against me. May the LORD, the Judge, decide today between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.

verses.kjv: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.
verses.decoded: However, the king of the Ammonites did not listen to the message Jephthah sent to him.

verses.kjv: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon.
verses.decoded: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he crossed over Gilead and Manasseh, and crossed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he crossed over to the people of Ammon.

verses.kjv: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands,
verses.decoded: And Jephthah made a promise to the LORD and said, If you definitely deliver the people of Ammon into my hands,

verses.kjv: Then it shall be, that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the LORD’s, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.
verses.decoded: Then it will happen that whatever comes out of the doors of my house to meet me when I return safely from the children of Ammon will definitely belong to the LORD, and I will offer it as a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hands.
verses.decoded: So Jephthah went to the people of Ammon to fight against them, and the LORD gave them into his hands.

verses.kjv: And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: And he struck them down from Aroer all the way to Minnith, including twenty cities, and to the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. In this way, the people of Ammon were defeated by the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And Jephthah came to Mizpeh unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she was his only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.
verses.decoded: And Jephthah went to Mizpeh to his house, and his daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and dancing; she was his only child; he had no other son or daughter besides her.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the LORD, and I cannot go back.
verses.decoded: When he saw her, he tore his clothes and said, "Oh no, my daughter! You have brought me great sorrow, and you are one of those who trouble me, because I have made a promise to the LORD, and I cannot take it back."

verses.kjv: And she said unto him, My father, if thou hast opened thy mouth unto the LORD, do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth; forasmuch as the LORD hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies, even of the children of Ammon.
verses.decoded: And she said to him, My father, if you have made a promise to the LORD, do to me what you said; because the LORD has taken revenge for you on your enemies, the people of Ammon.

verses.kjv: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.
verses.decoded: And she said to her father, Let this be done for me: leave me alone for two months, so that I can go up and down the mountains and mourn my virginity, along with my friends.

verses.kjv: And he said, Go. And he sent her away for two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.
verses.decoded: And he said, Go. And he sent her away for two months, and she went with her friends and mourned her virginity on the mountains.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Israel,
verses.decoded: At the end of two months, she returned to her father, who did to her as he had promised in his vow: and she did not have sexual relations with any man. This was a custom in Israel,

verses.kjv: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.
verses.decoded: The daughters of Israel went each year to mourn the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite for four days every year.

verses.kjv: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went northward, and said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire.
verses.decoded: The men of Ephraim gathered together and went north, and said to Jephthah, "Why did you go to fight against the children of Ammon without calling us to go with you? We will burn your house down with fire."

verses.kjv: And Jephthah said unto them, I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, ye delivered me not out of their hands.
verses.decoded: And Jephthah said to them, My people and I were in a serious conflict with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, you did not rescue me from their control.

verses.kjv: And when I saw that ye delivered me not, I put my life in my hands, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand: wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day, to fight against me?
verses.decoded: And when I saw that you did not rescue me, I risked my life and crossed over to fight against the children of Ammon, and the LORD gave them into my hand. So why have you come up to me today to fight against me?

verses.kjv: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, and among the Manassites.
verses.decoded: Then Jephthah gathered all the men of Gilead and fought against Ephraim. The men of Gilead defeated Ephraim because they said, 'You Gileadites are fugitives from Ephraim among the Ephraimites and among the Manassites.'

verses.kjv: And the Gileadites took the passages of Jordan before the Ephraimites: and it was so, that when those Ephraimites which were escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said unto him, Art thou an Ephraimite? If he said, Nay;
verses.decoded: The Gileadites controlled the crossing points of the Jordan River before the Ephraimites. So, when some Ephraimites who had escaped said, 'Let me cross over,' the men of Gilead asked them, 'Are you an Ephraimite?' If they said, 'No,'

verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.
verses.decoded: Then they said to him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: because he could not pronounce it correctly. Then they seized him and killed him at the crossing of the Jordan: and at that time forty-two thousand of the Ephraimites fell.

verses.kjv: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.
verses.decoded: Jephthah led Israel as a judge for six years. After that, Jephthah the Gileadite died and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.

verses.kjv: And after him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.
verses.decoded: After him, Ibzan from Bethlehem was the judge over Israel.

verses.kjv: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.
verses.decoded: He had thirty sons and thirty daughters. He sent his daughters away to other places and brought in thirty daughters from other places for his sons. He led Israel as a judge for seven years.

verses.kjv: Then died Ibzan, and was buried at Bethlehem.
verses.decoded: Then Ibzan died, and he was buried in Bethlehem.

verses.kjv: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.
verses.decoded: After him, Elon, a Zebulonite, was the judge of Israel; he led Israel for ten years.

verses.kjv: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.
verses.decoded: Elon the Zebulonite died and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.

verses.kjv: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.
verses.decoded: After him, Abdon, the son of Hillel, who was from Pirathon, led Israel as a judge.

verses.kjv: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Israel eight years.
verses.decoded: He had forty sons and thirty nephews, who rode on seventy young donkeys, and he led Israel as judge for eight years.

verses.kjv: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.
verses.decoded: Abdon, the son of Hillel the Pirathonite, died and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, on the hill of the Amalekites.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.
verses.decoded: The Israelites did evil again in the eyes of the LORD, and the LORD handed them over to the Philistines for forty years.

verses.kjv: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and bare not.
verses.decoded: There was a man from Zorah, from the family of the Danites, named Manoah; and his wife could not have children and was unable to give birth.

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto the woman, and said unto her, Behold now, thou art barren, and bearest not: but thou shalt conceive, and bear a son.
verses.decoded: And the angel of the LORD appeared to the woman and said to her, Look now, you are barren and do not have children, but you will become pregnant and give birth to a son.

verses.kjv: Now therefore beware, I pray thee, and drink not wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean thing:
verses.decoded: So now, be careful, I ask you, do not drink wine or strong drink, and do not eat anything unclean.

verses.kjv: For, lo, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and no razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.decoded: For, look, you will become pregnant and give birth to a son; no razor will come near his head: because the child will be a Nazarite dedicated to God from the womb: and he will start to rescue Israel from the power of the Philistines.

verses.kjv: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of God came unto me, and his countenance was like the countenance of an angel of God, very terrible: but I asked him not whence he was, neither told he me his name:
verses.decoded: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of God came to me, and his face was like the face of an angel of God, very frightening: but I did not ask him where he was from, nor did he tell me his name.

verses.kjv: But he said unto me, Behold, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean thing: for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death.
verses.decoded: But he said to me, Look, you will become pregnant and give birth to a son; and now do not drink wine or strong drink, and do not eat anything unclean, because the child will be a Nazarite dedicated to God from the time he is in the womb until the day he dies.

verses.kjv: Then Manoah intreated the LORD, and said, O my Lord, let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.
verses.decoded: Then Manoah pleaded with the LORD and said, O my Lord, please let the man of God whom you sent come back to us and teach us what we should do for the child who will be born.

verses.kjv: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field: but Manoah her husband was not with her.
verses.decoded: And God listened to Manoah's request; and the angel of God came again to the woman while she was sitting in the field, but her husband Manoah was not with her.

verses.kjv: And the woman made haste, and ran, and shewed her husband, and said unto him, Behold, the man hath appeared unto me, that came unto me the other day.
verses.decoded: And the woman hurried and ran to show her husband, and said to him, Look, the man who came to me the other day has appeared to me.

verses.kjv: And Manoah arose, and went after his wife, and came to the man, and said unto him, Art thou the man that spakest unto the woman? And he said, I am.
verses.decoded: And Manoah got up, went after his wife, came to the man, and asked him, Are you the man who spoke to the woman? And he said, I am.

verses.kjv: And Manoah said, Now let thy words come to pass. How shall we order the child, and how shall we do unto him?
verses.decoded: And Manoah said, Now let your words happen. How should we raise the child, and what should we do for him?

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware.
verses.decoded: And the angel of the LORD said to Manoah, Let the woman be careful to follow everything I told her.

verses.kjv: She may not eat of any thing that cometh of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: all that I commanded her let her observe.
verses.decoded: She must not eat anything that comes from the grapevine, and she must not drink wine or strong drink, nor eat anything unclean. She must obey everything I commanded her.

verses.kjv: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, I pray thee, let us detain thee, until we shall have made ready a kid for thee.
verses.decoded: And Manoah said to the angel of the LORD, Please stay with us until we prepare a young goat for you.

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Though thou detain me, I will not eat of thy bread: and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering, thou must offer it unto the LORD. For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of the LORD.
verses.decoded: And the angel of the LORD said to Manoah, Even if you ask me to stay, I will not eat your bread; and if you want to offer a burnt offering, you must offer it to the LORD. For Manoah did not know that he was an angel of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, What is thy name, that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour?
verses.decoded: And Manoah said to the angel of the LORD, What is your name, so that when your words come true we may honor you?

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is secret?
verses.decoded: And the angel of the LORD said to him, Why do you ask me my name, since it is a secret?

verses.kjv: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered it upon a rock unto the LORD: and the angel did wonderously; and Manoah and his wife looked on.
verses.decoded: So Manoah took a young goat along with a grain offering and offered it on a rock to the LORD; and the angel performed wonders, and Manoah and his wife watched.

verses.kjv: For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on it, and fell on their faces to the ground.
verses.decoded: It happened that when the flame rose toward heaven from the altar, the angel of the LORD went up in the flame of the altar. Manoah and his wife watched it and fell face down to the ground.

verses.kjv: But the angel of the LORD did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of the LORD.
verses.decoded: But the angel of the LORD did not appear again to Manoah and his wife. Then Manoah realized that he was an angel of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.
verses.decoded: And Manoah said to his wife, We will certainly die because we have seen God.

verses.kjv: But his wife said unto him, If the LORD were pleased to kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands, neither would he have shewed us all these things, nor would as at this time have told us such things as these.
verses.decoded: But his wife said to him, If the LORD wanted to kill us, he would not have accepted a burnt offering and a grain offering from us, nor would he have shown us all these things, or told us these things at this time.

verses.kjv: And the woman bare a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and the LORD blessed him.
verses.decoded: The woman gave birth to a son and named him Samson. The child grew, and the LORD blessed him.

verses.kjv: And the Spirit of the LORD began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.
verses.decoded: And the Spirit of the LORD began to influence him occasionally in the camp of Dan, located between Zorah and Eshtaol.

verses.kjv: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.
verses.decoded: Samson went down to Timnath and saw a woman in Timnath who was one of the daughters of the Philistines.

verses.kjv: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me to wife.
verses.decoded: And he went up and told his father and mother, saying, I have seen a woman in Timnath who is one of the daughters of the Philistines; so now get her for me as a wife.

verses.kjv: Then his father and his mother said unto him, Is there never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren, or among all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said unto his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.
verses.decoded: Then his father and his mother said to him, Is there no woman among the daughters of your brothers, or among all my people, that you must go to take a wife from the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said to his father, Get her for me, because I like her very much.

verses.kjv: But his father and his mother knew not that it was of the LORD, that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.
verses.decoded: But his father and his mother did not know that it was from the LORD, because he was looking for a reason to confront the Philistines, since at that time the Philistines ruled over Israel.

verses.kjv: Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnath, and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared against him.
verses.decoded: Then Samson went down, with his father and his mother, to Timnath, and they came to the vineyards of Timnath. Suddenly, a young lion roared at him.

verses.kjv: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.
verses.decoded: And the Spirit of the LORD came powerfully upon him, and he tore him apart as easily as he would tear a young goat, and he had nothing in his hand; but he did not tell his father or his mother what he had done.

verses.kjv: And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.
verses.decoded: Samson went down and spoke with the woman, and she pleased him very much.

verses.kjv: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.
verses.decoded: After some time, he went back to get her, and he stopped to look at the dead body of the lion. There was a swarm of bees and honey inside the dead lion.

verses.kjv: And he took thereof in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother, and he gave them, and they did eat: but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion.
verses.decoded: He took some of it in his hands and continued eating. Then he went to his father and mother and gave it to them, and they ate it. But he did not tell them that he had taken the honey from the carcass of the lion.

verses.kjv: So his father went down unto the woman: and Samson made there a feast; for so used the young men to do.
verses.decoded: So his father went to the woman, and Samson held a feast there because that was what young men used to do.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions to be with him.
verses.decoded: When they saw him, they brought thirty friends to be with him.

verses.kjv: And Samson said unto them, I will now put forth a riddle unto you: if ye can certainly declare it me within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty sheets and thirty change of garments:
verses.decoded: And Samson said to them, I will now give you a riddle: if you can definitely tell me the answer within the seven days of the feast, and figure it out, then I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothes.

verses.kjv: But if ye cannot declare it me, then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments. And they said unto him, Put forth thy riddle, that we may hear it.
verses.decoded: But if you cannot explain it to me, then you must give me thirty sheets and thirty sets of clothes. And they said to him, Tell us your riddle so that we can hear it.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.
verses.decoded: And he said to them, 'Food came out of the one who ate, and sweetness came out of the strong one.' But they could not explain the riddle within three days.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they said unto Samson’s wife, Entice thy husband, that he may declare unto us the riddle, lest we burn thee and thy father’s house with fire: have ye called us to take that we have? is it not so?
verses.decoded: On the seventh day, they said to Samson’s wife, "Persuade your husband to tell us the answer to the riddle, or we will burn you and your father’s house with fire. Did you invite us to take what we have? Isn’t that right?"

verses.kjv: And Samson’s wife wept before him, and said, Thou dost but hate me, and lovest me not: thou hast put forth a riddle unto the children of my people, and hast not told it me. And he said unto her, Behold, I have not told it my father nor my mother, and shall I tell it thee?
verses.decoded: And Samson’s wife cried in front of him and said, You just hate me and do not love me: you have given a riddle to the people of my people, and you have not told me. And he said to her, Look, I have not told it to my father or my mother, so should I tell it to you?

verses.kjv: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she lay sore upon him: and she told the riddle to the children of her people.
verses.decoded: And she cried in front of him for seven days while their celebration continued. On the seventh day, he explained the riddle to her because she was pressing him hard, and she then shared the riddle with the young men of her people.

verses.kjv: And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What is sweeter than honey? And what is stronger than a lion? And he said unto them, If ye had not plowed with my heifer, ye had not found out my riddle.
verses.decoded: And the men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What is sweeter than honey? And what is stronger than a lion? And he said to them, If you had not plowed with my heifer, you would not have found out my riddle.

verses.kjv: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, and slew thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle. And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father’s house.
verses.decoded: The Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, killed thirty men there, took their belongings, and gave new clothes to the men who explained the riddle. Then he became angry and went back to his father’s house.

verses.kjv: But Samson’s wife was given to his companion, whom he had used as his friend.
verses.decoded: But Samson’s wife was given to his companion, the man he had considered his friend.

verses.kjv: But it came to pass within a while after, in the time of wheat harvest, that Samson visited his wife with a kid; and he said, I will go in to my wife into the chamber. But her father would not suffer him to go in.
verses.decoded: After a short time, during the wheat harvest, Samson went to visit his wife with a young goat; and he said, I will go into my wife’s room. But her father would not allow him to go in.

verses.kjv: And her father said, I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to thy companion: is not her younger sister fairer than she? take her, I pray thee, instead of her.
verses.decoded: And her father said, I truly thought that you completely hated her; so I gave her to your companion. Isn't her younger sister more beautiful than she is? Please take her instead of her.

verses.kjv: And Samson said concerning them, Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do them a displeasure.
verses.decoded: And Samson said about them, Now I will be more innocent than the Philistines, even though I cause them trouble.

verses.kjv: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took firebrands, and turned tail to tail, and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails.
verses.decoded: Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, took torches, tied their tails together in pairs, and placed a torch between each pair of tails.

verses.kjv: And when he had set the brands on fire, he let them go into the standing corn of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also the standing corn, with the vineyards and olives.
verses.decoded: After he set the burning sticks on fire, he released them into the Philistines' standing grain, and they burned both the grain piles and the standing grain, along with the vineyards and olive trees.

verses.kjv: Then the Philistines said, Who hath done this? And they answered, Samson, the son in law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife, and given her to his companion. And the Philistines came up, and burnt her and her father with fire.
verses.decoded: Then the Philistines asked, Who did this? And they answered, Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife and given her to his companion. So the Philistines went up and burned her and her father with fire.

verses.kjv: And Samson said unto them, Though ye have done this, yet will I be avenged of you, and after that I will cease.
verses.decoded: And Samson said to them, Even though you have done this, I will still take revenge on you, and after that I will stop.

verses.kjv: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter: and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam.
verses.decoded: And he struck them with a great slaughter, hitting them all over; then he went down and lived at the top of the rock Etam.

verses.kjv: Then the Philistines went up, and pitched in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.
verses.decoded: Then the Philistines went up and camped in Judah, and spread out in Lehi.

verses.kjv: And the men of Judah said, Why are ye come up against us? And they answered, To bind Samson are we come up, to do to him as he hath done to us.
verses.decoded: And the men of Judah said, Why have you come up against us? And they answered, We have come to capture Samson, to do to him as he has done to us.

verses.kjv: Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam, and said to Samson, Knowest thou not that the Philistines are rulers over us? what is this that thou hast done unto us? And he said unto them, As they did unto me, so have I done unto them.
verses.decoded: Then three thousand men from Judah went to the top of the rock Etam and said to Samson, "Don't you know that the Philistines rule over us? What is this thing you have done to us?" And he said to them, "Just as they did to me, I have done to them."

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, We are come down to bind thee, that we may deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines. And Samson said unto them, Swear unto me, that ye will not fall upon me yourselves.
verses.decoded: And they said to him, We have come down to bind you so that we can hand you over to the Philistines. And Samson said to them, Swear to me that you will not attack me yourselves.

verses.kjv: And they spake unto him, saying, No; but we will bind thee fast, and deliver thee into their hand: but surely we will not kill thee. And they bound him with two new cords, and brought him up from the rock.
verses.decoded: And they said to him, No; but we will tie you up tightly and hand you over to them; however, we will definitely not kill you. So they tied him with two new ropes and brought him up from the rock.

verses.kjv: And when he came unto Lehi, the Philistines shouted against him: and the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and the cords that were upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire, and his bands loosed from off his hands.
verses.decoded: When he arrived at Lehi, the Philistines shouted at him, but the Spirit of the LORD came powerfully upon him, and the cords on his arms became like flax that has been burned by fire, and the bands fell off his hands.

verses.kjv: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.
verses.decoded: He found a fresh donkey's jawbone, reached out his hand, grabbed it, and killed a thousand men with it.

verses.kjv: And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men.
verses.decoded: And Samson said, With the jawbone of a donkey, pile upon pile, with the jaw of a donkey I have killed a thousand men.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking, that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand, and called that place Ramathlehi.
verses.decoded: After he finished speaking, he threw the jawbone out of his hand and named that place Ramath-lehi.

verses.kjv: And he was sore athirst, and called on the LORD, and said, Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant: and now shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?
verses.decoded: And he was very thirsty, and called on the LORD, and said, You have given this great victory into the hand of your servant; and now will I die from thirst and be captured by the uncircumcised?

verses.kjv: But God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: wherefore he called the name thereof Enhakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.
verses.decoded: But God split open a hollow place in the jawbone, and water came out of it; and when he drank, his strength returned, and he was revived. Therefore, he called the place En-hakkore, which means 'Spring of the Caller,' in Lehi to this day.

verses.kjv: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.
verses.decoded: He led Israel as a judge during the time when the Philistines ruled for twenty years.

verses.kjv: Then went Samson to Gaza, and saw there an harlot, and went in unto her.
verses.decoded: Then Samson went to Gaza, saw a prostitute there, and went to her.

verses.kjv: And it was told the Gazites, saying, Samson is come hither. And they compassed him in, and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, In the morning, when it is day, we shall kill him.
verses.decoded: The people of Gaza were told, "Samson has come here." They surrounded him and waited for him all night at the city gate, staying quiet all night, saying, "In the morning, when it is daylight, we will kill him."

verses.kjv: And Samson lay till midnight, and arose at midnight, and took the doors of the gate of the city, and the two posts, and went away with them, bar and all, and put them upon his shoulders, and carried them up to the top of an hill that is before Hebron.
verses.decoded: Samson stayed in bed until midnight, then got up at midnight, took the doors of the city gate and the two posts, and carried them away, including the bar, placed them on his shoulders, and carried them to the top of a hill in front of Hebron.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass afterward, that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
verses.decoded: After some time, he fell in love with a woman in the valley of Sorek, and her name was Delilah.

verses.kjv: And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and said unto her, Entice him, and see wherein his great strength lieth, and by what means we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him: and we will give thee every one of us eleven hundred pieces of silver.
verses.decoded: The leaders of the Philistines came to her and said to her, "Seduce him and find out where his great strength is, and how we can defeat him so we can tie him up and harm him. Each of us will give you eleven hundred pieces of silver."

verses.kjv: And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray thee, wherein thy great strength lieth, and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict thee.
verses.decoded: And Delilah said to Samson, Please tell me where your great strength comes from, and with what you could be bound to hurt you.

verses.kjv: And Samson said unto her, If they bind me with seven green withs that were never dried, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.
verses.decoded: And Samson said to her, If they tie me up with seven fresh green branches that have never dried, then I will become weak and be like any other man.

verses.kjv: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green withs which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.
verses.decoded: Then the leaders of the Philistines brought her seven fresh green branches that had not dried, and she tied him up with them.

verses.kjv: Now there were men lying in wait, abiding with her in the chamber. And she said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he brake the withs, as a thread of tow is broken when it toucheth the fire. So his strength was not known.
verses.decoded: Now there were men lying in wait, staying with her in the room. And she said to him, The Philistines are attacking you, Samson. And he broke the ropes as easily as a piece of fiber breaks when it touches fire. So his strength was not discovered.

verses.kjv: And Delilah said unto Samson, Behold, thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: now tell me, I pray thee, wherewith thou mightest be bound.
verses.decoded: And Delilah said to Samson, Look, you have mocked me and told me lies; now please tell me how you could be bound.

verses.kjv: And he said unto her, If they bind me fast with new ropes that never were occupied, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.
verses.decoded: And he said to her, If they tie me tightly with new ropes that have never been used, then I will become weak and be like any other man.

verses.kjv: Delilah therefore took new ropes, and bound him therewith, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And there were liers in wait abiding in the chamber. And he brake them from off his arms like a thread.
verses.decoded: Delilah then took new ropes and tied him up with them, and said to him, "The Philistines are attacking you, Samson." There were men hiding in the room waiting. He broke the ropes from his arms as easily as breaking a thread.

verses.kjv: And Delilah said unto Samson, Hitherto thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: tell me wherewith thou mightest be bound. And he said unto her, If thou weavest the seven locks of my head with the web.
verses.decoded: And Delilah said to Samson, Until now you have mocked me and told me lies; tell me how you could be bound. And he said to her, If you weave the seven locks of my head into the web.

verses.kjv: And she fastened it with the pin, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he awaked out of his sleep, and went away with the pin of the beam, and with the web.
verses.decoded: And she secured it with the pin, and said to him, The Philistines are attacking you, Samson. Then he woke up from his sleep and left, taking the pin of the beam and the covering with him.

verses.kjv: And she said unto him, How canst thou say, I love thee, when thine heart is not with me? thou hast mocked me these three times, and hast not told me wherein thy great strength lieth.
verses.decoded: And she said to him, How can you say, I love you, when your heart is not with me? You have deceived me these three times, and you have not told me where your great strength lies.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when she pressed him daily with her words, and urged him, so that his soul was vexed unto death;
verses.decoded: And it happened that when she spoke to him every day and kept urging him, his spirit became deeply troubled to the point of despair;

verses.kjv: That he told her all his heart, and said unto her, There hath not come a razor upon mine head; for I have been a Nazarite unto God from my mother’s womb: if I be shaven, then my strength will go from me, and I shall become weak, and be like any other man.
verses.decoded: He told her everything in his heart and said to her, No razor has ever touched my head, because I have been a Nazarite dedicated to God from my mother's womb. If my head is shaved, my strength will leave me, and I will become weak and be like any other man.

verses.kjv: And when Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, Come up this once, for he hath shewed me all his heart. Then the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and brought money in their hand.
verses.decoded: When Delilah saw that he had told her everything, she sent for the rulers of the Philistines and said, "Come up once more, because he has told me everything." Then the rulers of the Philistines came to her and brought money in their hands.

verses.kjv: And she made him sleep upon her knees; and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.
verses.decoded: She made him sleep on her knees, then she called a man and had him shave off the seven locks of his head. She started to hurt him, and his strength left him.

verses.kjv: And she said, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he awoke out of his sleep, and said, I will go out as at other times before, and shake myself. And he wist not that the LORD was departed from him.
verses.decoded: And she said, The Philistines are attacking you, Samson. And he woke up from his sleep and said, I will go out as I have before and shake myself free. But he did not know that the LORD had left him.

verses.kjv: But the Philistines took him, and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass; and he did grind in the prison house.
verses.decoded: But the Philistines captured him, blinded him, brought him to Gaza, and chained him with bronze shackles; and he was forced to grind grain in the prison.

verses.kjv: Howbeit the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaven.
verses.decoded: However, the hair on his head started to grow back after it was shaved.

verses.kjv: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together for to offer a great sacrifice unto Dagon their god, and to rejoice: for they said, Our god hath delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.
verses.decoded: Then the leaders of the Philistines gathered together to offer a great sacrifice to Dagon their god and to celebrate, because they said, Our god has delivered Samson, our enemy, into our hands.

verses.kjv: And when the people saw him, they praised their god: for they said, Our god hath delivered into our hands our enemy, and the destroyer of our country, which slew many of us.
verses.decoded: When the people saw him, they praised their god because they said, Our god has given us our enemy, the one who destroyed our country and killed many of us.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when their hearts were merry, that they said, Call for Samson, that he may make us sport. And they called for Samson out of the prison house; and he made them sport: and they set him between the pillars.
verses.decoded: It happened that when they were feeling happy, they said, "Call Samson so he can entertain us." They called Samson out of the prison, and he entertained them. Then they placed him between the pillars.

verses.kjv: And Samson said unto the lad that held him by the hand, Suffer me that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth, that I may lean upon them.
verses.decoded: And Samson said to the young man who was holding his hand, Allow me to feel the pillars that support the house, so that I can lean on them.

verses.kjv: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and there were upon the roof about three thousand men and women, that beheld while Samson made sport.
verses.decoded: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the leaders of the Philistines were there; and there were about three thousand men and women on the roof watching while Samson entertained them.

verses.kjv: And Samson called unto the LORD, and said, O Lord God, remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.
verses.decoded: And Samson called to the LORD and said, O Lord GOD, please remember me and give me strength, I ask you, just this once, O God, so that I may immediately take revenge on the Philistines for my two eyes.

verses.kjv: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood, and on which it was borne up, of the one with his right hand, and of the other with his left.
verses.decoded: Samson grabbed the two central pillars that supported the house, holding one with his right hand and the other with his left.

verses.kjv: And Samson said, Let me die with the Philistines. And he bowed himself with all his might; and the house fell upon the lords, and upon all the people that were therein. So the dead which he slew at his death were more than they which he slew in his life.
verses.decoded: And Samson said, Let me die with the Philistines. Then he pushed with all his strength, and the building collapsed on the rulers and all the people inside. So the number of people he killed when he died was greater than the number he killed while he was alive.

verses.kjv: Then his brethren and all the house of his father came down, and took him, and brought him up, and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the buryingplace of Manoah his father. And he judged Israel twenty years.
