verses.decoded: Then his brothers and all the family of his father came down, took him, brought him up, and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the burial place of Manoah his father. He led Israel for twenty years.

verses.kjv: And there was a man of mount Ephraim, whose name was Micah.
verses.decoded: There was a man from Mount Ephraim named Micah.

verses.kjv: And he said unto his mother, The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from thee, about which thou cursedst, and spakest of also in mine ears, behold, the silver is with me; I took it. And his mother said, Blessed be thou of the LORD, my son.
verses.decoded: And he said to his mother, The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from you, about which you cursed and also spoke to me about, look, the silver is with me; I took it. And his mother said, May the LORD bless you, my son.

verses.kjv: And when he had restored the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, his mother said, I had wholly dedicated the silver unto the LORD from my hand for my son, to make a graven image and a molten image: now therefore I will restore it unto thee.
verses.decoded: And when he had returned the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, his mother said, I had completely dedicated the silver to the LORD from my hand for my son, to make a carved image and a cast image; now therefore I will return it to you.

verses.kjv: Yet he restored the money unto his mother; and his mother took two hundred shekels of silver, and gave them to the founder, who made thereof a graven image and a molten image: and they were in the house of Micah.
verses.decoded: He gave the money back to his mother, and his mother took two hundred shekels of silver and gave it to the craftsman, who made a carved image and a cast metal image from it. They were in the house of Micah.

verses.kjv: And the man Micah had an house of gods, and made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.
verses.decoded: And the man Micah had a house for gods, and made an ephod and teraphim, and dedicated one of his sons, who became his priest.

verses.kjv: In those days there was no king in Israel, but every man did that which was right in his own eyes.
verses.decoded: At that time, Israel did not have a king, and each person did what they thought was right.

verses.kjv: And there was a young man out of Bethlehemjudah of the family of Judah, who was a Levite, and he sojourned there.
verses.decoded: There was a young man from Bethlehemjudah, from the family of Judah, who was a Levite, and he was living there temporarily.

verses.kjv: And the man departed out of the city from Bethlehemjudah to sojourn where he could find a place: and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah, as he journeyed.
verses.decoded: The man left the city of Bethlehem in Judah to live temporarily wherever he could find a place, and he came to Mount Ephraim to the house of Micah as he traveled.

verses.kjv: And Micah said unto him, Whence comest thou? And he said unto him, I am a Levite of Bethlehemjudah, and I go to sojourn where I may find a place.
verses.decoded: And Micah asked him, Where do you come from? And he answered him, I am a Levite from Bethlehemjudah, and I am going to stay temporarily wherever I can find a place.

verses.kjv: And Micah said unto him, Dwell with me, and be unto me a father and a priest, and I will give thee ten shekels of silver by the year, and a suit of apparel, and thy victuals. So the Levite went in.
verses.decoded: And Micah said to him, Live with me and be like a father and a priest to me, and I will give you ten shekels of silver each year, along with a set of clothes and your food. So the Levite went in.

verses.kjv: And the Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was unto him as one of his sons.
verses.decoded: The Levite was happy to live with the man, and the young man was like one of his own sons to him.

verses.kjv: And Micah consecrated the Levite; and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.
verses.decoded: And Micah set apart the Levite; and the young man became his priest and lived in Micah's house.

verses.kjv: Then said Micah, Now know I that the LORD will do me good, seeing I have a Levite to my priest.
verses.decoded: Then Micah said, Now I know that the LORD will bless me because I have a Levite as my priest.

verses.kjv: In those days there was no king in Israel: and in those days the tribe of the Danites sought them an inheritance to dwell in; for unto that day all their inheritance had not fallen unto them among the tribes of Israel.
verses.decoded: At that time, there was no king in Israel. During that time, the tribe of Dan was looking for a place to settle because they had not yet received their full inheritance among the tribes of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts, men of valour, from Zorah, and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land, and to search it; and they said unto them, Go, search the land: who when they came to mount Ephraim, to the house of Micah, they lodged there.
verses.decoded: The people of Dan sent five men from their families, brave men from Zorah and Eshtaol, to scout the land and explore it; and they said to them, Go and explore the land. When they came to Mount Ephraim, to the house of Micah, they stayed there.

verses.kjv: When they were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite: and they turned in thither, and said unto him, Who brought thee hither? and what makest thou in this place? and what hast thou here?
verses.decoded: When they were near the house of Micah, they recognized the voice of the young Levite. They turned and went inside, and asked him, "Who brought you here? What are you doing in this place? What do you have here?"

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me, and hath hired me, and I am his priest.
verses.decoded: And he said to them, This is how Micah treats me, he has hired me, and I am his priest.

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, Ask counsel, we pray thee, of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.
verses.decoded: And they said to him, Please ask God for guidance so that we may know if the way we are going will be successful.

verses.kjv: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace: before the LORD is your way wherein ye go.
verses.decoded: And the priest said to them, Go in peace; the way you are going is before the LORD.

verses.kjv: Then the five men departed, and came to Laish, and saw the people that were therein, how they dwelt careless, after the manner of the Zidonians, quiet and secure; and there was no magistrate in the land, that might put them to shame in any thing; and they were far from the Zidonians, and had no business with any man.
verses.decoded: Then the five men left and went to Laish, and saw the people living there, how they lived carelessly, like the Zidonians, peaceful and safe; and there was no ruler in the land who could correct them in anything; and they were far from the Zidonians, and had no dealings with anyone.

verses.kjv: And they came unto their brethren to Zorah and Eshtaol: and their brethren said unto them, What say ye?
verses.decoded: They went to their relatives in Zorah and Eshtaol, and their relatives asked them, "What do you say?"

verses.kjv: And they said, Arise, that we may go up against them: for we have seen the land, and, behold, it is very good: and are ye still? be not slothful to go, and to enter to possess the land.
verses.decoded: And they said, Get up so that we can go against them, because we have seen the land, and look, it is very good. Are you still standing there? Do not be lazy to go and enter to take possession of the land.

verses.kjv: When ye go, ye shall come unto a people secure, and to a large land: for God hath given it into your hands; a place where there is no want of any thing that is in the earth.
verses.decoded: When you go, you will come to a peaceful people and a large land, because God has given it into your hands; a place where there is no lack of anything found on the earth.

verses.kjv: And there went from thence of the family of the Danites, out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol, six hundred men appointed with weapons of war.
verses.decoded: And from there, six hundred men from the family of the Danites, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, went out, armed for battle.

verses.kjv: And they went up, and pitched in Kirjathjearim, in Judah: wherefore they called that place Mahanehdan unto this day: behold, it is behind Kirjathjearim.
verses.decoded: They went up and camped at Kirjath-jearim in Judah. Because of this, they named that place Mahaneh-dan until today. Look, it is behind Kirjath-jearim.

verses.kjv: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim, and came unto the house of Micah.
verses.decoded: Then they went from there to Mount Ephraim and arrived at the house of Micah.

verses.kjv: Then answered the five men that went to spy out the country of Laish, and said unto their brethren, Do ye know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a graven image, and a molten image? now therefore consider what ye have to do.
verses.decoded: Then the five men who went to spy out the country of Laish answered and said to their brothers, "Do you know that in these houses there is an ephod, and teraphim, and a carved image, and a cast metal image? Now then, decide what you should do."

verses.kjv: And they turned thitherward, and came to the house of the young man the Levite, even unto the house of Micah, and saluted him.
verses.decoded: And they turned in that direction and came to the house of the young Levite, to the house of Micah, and greeted him.

verses.kjv: And the six hundred men appointed with their weapons of war, which were of the children of Dan, stood by the entering of the gate.
verses.decoded: And the six hundred men equipped with their weapons of war, who were from the tribe of Dan, stood by the entrance of the gate.

verses.kjv: And the five men that went to spy out the land went up, and came in thither, and took the graven image, and the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image: and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men that were appointed with weapons of war.
verses.decoded: The five men who went to spy out the land went up and entered there, and took the carved idol, the ephod, the household gods, and the molten image; and the priest stood at the entrance of the gate with the six hundred men who were armed for battle.

verses.kjv: And these went into Micah’s house, and fetched the carved image, the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image. Then said the priest unto them, What do ye?
verses.decoded: And they went into Micah’s house and took the carved image, the ephod, the teraphim, and the molten image. Then the priest said to them, What are you doing?

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, Hold thy peace, lay thine hand upon thy mouth, and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest: is it better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man, or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel?
verses.decoded: And they said to him, Be quiet, put your hand over your mouth, and come with us, and be a father and a priest to us: is it better for you to be a priest for the house of one man, or to be a priest for a tribe and a family in Israel?

verses.kjv: And the priest’s heart was glad, and he took the ephod, and the teraphim, and the graven image, and went in the midst of the people.
verses.decoded: The priest was happy, and he took the ephod, the teraphim, and the carved idol, and went among the people.

verses.kjv: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them.
verses.decoded: So they turned and left, leading the children, the animals, and the carts ahead of them.

verses.kjv: And when they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men that were in the houses near to Micah’s house were gathered together, and overtook the children of Dan.
verses.decoded: And when they were a considerable distance from Micah's house, the men who were in the houses near Micah's house gathered together and caught up with the people of Dan.

verses.kjv: And they cried unto the children of Dan. And they turned their faces, and said unto Micah, What aileth thee, that thou comest with such a company?
verses.decoded: And they called out to the people of Dan. They turned around and said to Micah, What is wrong with you that you come with such a group?

verses.kjv: And he said, Ye have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and ye are gone away: and what have I more? and what is this that ye say unto me, What aileth thee?
verses.decoded: And he said, You have taken away my gods that I made, and the priest, and you have left: what else do I have? And why do you say to me, 'What is wrong with you?'

verses.kjv: And the children of Dan said unto him, Let not thy voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows run upon thee, and thou lose thy life, with the lives of thy household.
verses.decoded: And the children of Dan said to him, Do not let your voice be heard among us, or angry men will come against you, and you will lose your life along with the lives of your family.

verses.kjv: And the children of Dan went their way: and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back unto his house.
verses.decoded: The people of Dan went on their way, and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned around and went back to his house.

verses.kjv: And they took the things which Micah had made, and the priest which he had, and came unto Laish, unto a people that were at quiet and secure: and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and burnt the city with fire.
verses.decoded: They took the things that Micah had made, and the priest he had, and went to Laish, to a people who were living peacefully and safely. They attacked them with the sword and burned the city with fire.

verses.kjv: And there was no deliverer, because it was far from Zidon, and they had no business with any man; and it was in the valley that lieth by Bethrehob. And they built a city, and dwelt therein.
verses.decoded: There was no one to rescue them because it was far from Zidon, and they had no dealings with anyone; it was in the valley near Beth-rehob. They built a city there and lived in it.

verses.kjv: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born unto Israel: howbeit the name of the city was Laish at the first.
verses.decoded: And they named the city Dan, after the name of Dan their ancestor, who was born to Israel; however, the city was originally called Laish.

verses.kjv: And the children of Dan set up the graven image: and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.
verses.decoded: The people of Dan set up the carved idol, and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, along with his sons, served as priests for the tribe of Dan until the time when the land was taken into captivity.

verses.kjv: And they set them up Micah’s graven image, which he made, all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.
verses.decoded: And they set up Micah’s carved image, which he made, during the entire time that the house of God was in Shiloh.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, when there was no king in Israel, that there was a certain Levite sojourning on the side of mount Ephraim, who took to him a concubine out of Bethlehemjudah.
verses.decoded: At that time, when Israel had no king, there was a Levite living in the region of Mount Ephraim who took a concubine from Bethlehem in Judah.

verses.kjv: And his concubine played the whore against him, and went away from him unto her father’s house to Bethlehemjudah, and was there four whole months.
verses.decoded: And his concubine was unfaithful to him, and she left him and went to her father's house in Bethlehem Judah, and stayed there for four full months.

verses.kjv: And her husband arose, and went after her, to speak friendly unto her, and to bring her again, having his servant with him, and a couple of asses: and she brought him into her father’s house: and when the father of the damsel saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.
verses.decoded: And her husband got up and went after her to speak kindly to her and bring her back, having his servant with him and two donkeys; and she brought him into her father’s house; and when the father of the young woman saw him, he was happy to see him.

verses.kjv: And his father in law, the damsel’s father, retained him; and he abode with him three days: so they did eat and drink, and lodged there.
verses.decoded: And his father-in-law, the young woman's father, kept him there; and he stayed with him for three days. During that time, they ate and drank and spent the nights there.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the fourth day, when they arose early in the morning, that he rose up to depart: and the damsel’s father said unto his son in law, Comfort thine heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward go your way.
verses.decoded: On the fourth day, early in the morning, they got up, and he got ready to leave. The young woman’s father said to his son-in-law, "Strengthen yourself with a piece of bread, then you can go on your way."

verses.kjv: And they sat down, and did eat and drink both of them together: for the damsel’s father had said unto the man, Be content, I pray thee, and tarry all night, and let thine heart be merry.
verses.decoded: And they sat down and ate and drank together, because the young woman’s father had said to the man, Please be satisfied, stay all night, and enjoy yourself.

verses.kjv: And when the man rose up to depart, his father in law urged him: therefore he lodged there again.
verses.decoded: When the man got ready to leave, his father-in-law encouraged him to stay, so he stayed there again.

verses.kjv: And he arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart: and the damsel’s father said, Comfort thine heart, I pray thee. And they tarried until afternoon, and they did eat both of them.
verses.decoded: And he got up early in the morning on the fifth day to leave, and the young woman’s father said, Please be comforted. So they stayed until the afternoon, and both of them ate.

verses.kjv: And when the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father in law, the damsel’s father, said unto him, Behold, now the day draweth toward evening, I pray you tarry all night: behold, the day groweth to an end, lodge here, that thine heart may be merry; and to morrow get you early on your way, that thou mayest go home.
verses.decoded: When the man got up to leave, he, his concubine, his servant, his father-in-law, the girl's father, said to him, Look, the day is coming to an end, please stay all night; the day is ending, stay here so you can be happy, and tomorrow leave early so you can go home.

verses.kjv: But the man would not tarry that night, but he rose up and departed, and came over against Jebus, which is Jerusalem; and there were with him two asses saddled, his concubine also was with him.
verses.decoded: But the man did not stay that night; instead, he got up and left, and came near Jebus, which is Jerusalem; and he had two saddled donkeys with him, and his concubine was also with him.

verses.kjv: And when they were by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said unto his master, Come, I pray thee, and let us turn in into this city of the Jebusites, and lodge in it.
verses.decoded: When they were near Jebus, the day was almost over; and the servant said to his master, Please come, and let us go into this city of the Jebusites and stay there for the night.

verses.kjv: And his master said unto him, We will not turn aside hither into the city of a stranger, that is not of the children of Israel; we will pass over to Gibeah.
verses.decoded: And his master said to him, We will not turn aside here into the city of a foreigner, who is not one of the children of Israel; we will go on to Gibeah.

verses.kjv: And he said unto his servant, Come, and let us draw near to one of these places to lodge all night, in Gibeah, or in Ramah.
verses.decoded: And he said to his servant, Come, and let us go near to one of these places to stay overnight, in Gibeah or in Ramah.

verses.kjv: And they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down upon them when they were by Gibeah, which belongeth to Benjamin.
verses.decoded: They continued traveling on their way, and the sun set while they were near Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin.

verses.kjv: And they turned aside thither, to go in and to lodge in Gibeah: and when he went in, he sat him down in a street of the city: for there was no man that took them into his house to lodging.
verses.decoded: They turned aside there to enter and stay overnight in Gibeah. When he entered, he sat down in a street of the city because no one took them into his house to stay.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there came an old man from his work out of the field at even, which was also of mount Ephraim; and he sojourned in Gibeah: but the men of the place were Benjamites.
verses.decoded: Look, an old man came from his work in the field in the evening; he was also from Mount Ephraim. He was staying temporarily in Gibeah, but the people of that place were Benjamites.

verses.kjv: And when he had lifted up his eyes, he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city: and the old man said, Whither goest thou? and whence comest thou?
verses.decoded: When he looked up, he saw a traveler on the city street, and the old man said, Where are you going? And where do you come from?

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, We are passing from Bethlehemjudah toward the side of mount Ephraim; from thence am I: and I went to Bethlehemjudah, but I am now going to the house of the LORD; and there is no man that receiveth me to house.
verses.decoded: And he said to him, We are traveling from Bethlehem in Judah toward the area of Mount Ephraim; that is where I am from: and I went to Bethlehem in Judah, but now I am going to the house of the LORD; and there is no one who will take me into their home.

verses.kjv: Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for thy handmaid, and for the young man which is with thy servants: there is no want of any thing.
verses.decoded: There is both straw and food for our donkeys; and there is bread and wine also for me, for your servant woman, and for the young man who is with your servants: nothing is lacking.

verses.kjv: And the old man said, Peace be with thee; howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me; only lodge not in the street.
verses.decoded: And the old man said, Peace be with you; however, let all your needs be my responsibility; just do not stay in the street.

verses.kjv: So he brought him into his house, and gave provender unto the asses: and they washed their feet, and did eat and drink.
verses.decoded: So he brought him into his house and gave food to the donkeys. Then they washed their feet and ate and drank.

verses.kjv: Now as they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain sons of Belial, beset the house round about, and beat at the door, and spake to the master of the house, the old man, saying, Bring forth the man that came into thine house, that we may know him.
verses.decoded: While they were enjoying themselves, the men of the city, some worthless people, surrounded the house, knocked on the door, and said to the owner of the house, the old man, "Bring out the man who came into your house so we can get to know him."

verses.kjv: And the man, the master of the house, went out unto them, and said unto them, Nay, my brethren, nay, I pray you, do not so wickedly; seeing that this man is come into mine house, do not this folly.
verses.decoded: The man, the owner of the house, went out to them and said, No, my brothers, no, I beg you, do not act so wickedly; since this man has come into my house, do not do this foolish thing.

verses.kjv: Behold, here is my daughter a maiden, and his concubine; them I will bring out now, and humble ye them, and do with them what seemeth good unto you: but unto this man do not so vile a thing.
verses.decoded: Look, here is my virgin daughter and his concubine; I will bring them out to you now, and you may treat them as you please and do whatever seems good to you, but do not do such a vile thing to this man.

verses.kjv: But the men would not hearken to him: so the man took his concubine, and brought her forth unto them; and they knew her, and abused her all the night until the morning: and when the day began to spring, they let her go.
verses.decoded: But the men would not listen to him, so the man took his concubine and brought her out to them. They sexually assaulted her and abused her all night until morning. When day began to break, they let her go.

verses.kjv: Then came the woman in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her lord was, till it was light.
verses.decoded: Then the woman came at dawn and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her husband was, until it became light.

verses.kjv: And her lord rose up in the morning, and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way: and, behold, the woman his concubine was fallen down at the door of the house, and her hands were upon the threshold.
verses.decoded: Her master got up in the morning, opened the doors of the house, and went out to leave; and look, the woman his concubine had fallen down at the door of the house, with her hands on the threshold.

verses.kjv: And he said unto her, Up, and let us be going. But none answered. Then the man took her up upon an ass, and the man rose up, and gat him unto his place.
verses.decoded: And he said to her, Get up, and let us go. But no one answered. Then the man put her on a donkey, and he got up and went to his home.

verses.kjv: And when he was come into his house, he took a knife, and laid hold on his concubine, and divided her, together with her bones, into twelve pieces, and sent her into all the coasts of Israel.
verses.decoded: When he arrived at his house, he took a knife, grabbed his concubine, cut her into twelve pieces including her bones, and sent the pieces throughout all the regions of Israel.

verses.kjv: And it was so, that all that saw it said, There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt unto this day: consider of it, take advice, and speak your minds.
verses.decoded: And it happened that everyone who saw it said, There has been no such act done or seen from the day the children of Israel came out of the land of Egypt until this day: think about it, discuss it, and share your opinions.

verses.kjv: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was gathered together as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba, with the land of Gilead, unto the LORD in Mizpeh.
verses.decoded: Then all the people of Israel went out, and the assembly gathered together as one group, from Dan all the way to Beer-sheba, including the land of Gilead, to the LORD at Mizpeh.

verses.kjv: And the chief of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.
verses.decoded: The leaders of all the people, from all the tribes of Israel, gathered together in the assembly of God's people, four hundred thousand soldiers who carried swords.

verses.kjv: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpeh.) Then said the children of Israel, Tell us, how was this wickedness?
verses.decoded: (Now the people of Benjamin heard that the people of Israel had gone up to Mizpeh.) Then the people of Israel said, Tell us, how did this wickedness happen?

verses.kjv: And the Levite, the husband of the woman that was slain, answered and said, I came into Gibeah that belongeth to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to lodge.
verses.decoded: The Levite, the husband of the woman who was killed, answered and said, I came to Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin, with my concubine, to stay overnight.

verses.kjv: And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and beset the house round about upon me by night, and thought to have slain me: and my concubine have they forced, that she is dead.
verses.decoded: The men of Gibeah attacked me, surrounded the house at night to kill me, and they forced my concubine, so she died.

verses.kjv: And I took my concubine, and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel: for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.
verses.decoded: I took my concubine, cut her into pieces, and sent her throughout all the land that belongs to Israel because they have committed sexual immorality and foolishness in Israel.

verses.kjv: Behold, ye are all children of Israel; give here your advice and counsel.
verses.decoded: Look, you are all children of Israel; give your advice and counsel here.

verses.kjv: And all the people arose as one man, saying, We will not any of us go to his tent, neither will we any of us turn into his house.
verses.decoded: And all the people stood up together, saying, None of us will go to his tent, and none of us will enter his house.

verses.kjv: But now this shall be the thing which we will do to Gibeah; we will go up by lot against it;
verses.decoded: But now this is what we will do to Gibeah: we will choose by lot who will go up against it.

verses.kjv: And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and an hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to fetch victual for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that they have wrought in Israel.
verses.decoded: And we will take ten men out of every hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and one hundred out of every thousand, and one thousand out of every ten thousand, to bring food for the people, so that they may act when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the evil they have done in Israel.

verses.kjv: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.
verses.decoded: All the men of Israel gathered against the city, united as one person.

verses.kjv: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, What wickedness is this that is done among you?
verses.decoded: The tribes of Israel sent men throughout the entire tribe of Benjamin, asking, What evil is this that has been done among you?

verses.kjv: Now therefore deliver us the men, the children of Belial, which are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death, and put away evil from Israel. But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel:
verses.decoded: Now then, hand over to us the men, the worthless people, who are in Gibeah, so that we can kill them and remove evil from Israel. But the people of Benjamin refused to listen to the voice of their fellow Israelites:

verses.kjv: But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: But the people of Benjamin gathered themselves from the cities to Gibeah to go out and fight against the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the children of Benjamin were numbered at that time out of the cities twenty and six thousand men that drew sword, beside the inhabitants of Gibeah, which were numbered seven hundred chosen men.
verses.decoded: At that time, the men of Benjamin who were counted from the cities were twenty-six thousand men who drew the sword, in addition to the inhabitants of Gibeah, who were seven hundred chosen men.

verses.kjv: Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth, and not miss.
verses.decoded: Among all these people there were seven hundred chosen left-handed men; each one could sling stones at a very small distance and not miss.

verses.kjv: And the men of Israel, beside Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword: all these were men of war.
verses.decoded: The men of Israel, excluding Benjamin, were counted as four hundred thousand men who carried swords; all of these were warriors.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel arose, and went up to the house of God, and asked counsel of God, and said, Which of us shall go up first to the battle against the children of Benjamin? And the LORD said, Judah shall go up first.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel got up and went to the house of God, asked God for advice, and said, 'Who among us should go first to fight against the people of Benjamin?' The LORD said, 'Judah will go first.'

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel rose up in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel got up in the morning and set up camp near Gibeah.

verses.kjv: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah.
verses.decoded: The men of Israel went out to fight against Benjamin, and they arranged themselves to battle against them at Gibeah.

verses.kjv: And the children of Benjamin came forth out of Gibeah, and destroyed down to the ground of the Israelites that day twenty and two thousand men.
verses.decoded: The people of Benjamin came out of Gibeah and killed twenty-two thousand Israelite men that day.

verses.kjv: And the people the men of Israel encouraged themselves, and set their battle again in array in the place where they put themselves in array the first day.
verses.decoded: The men of Israel encouraged themselves and arranged their battle formation again in the same place where they had arranged themselves on the first day.

verses.kjv: (And the children of Israel went up and wept before the LORD until even, and asked counsel of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother? And the LORD said, Go up against him.)
verses.decoded: The Israelites went up and cried out to the LORD until evening, and they asked the LORD for advice, saying, Should I go up again to fight against the people of Benjamin, my brother? The LORD said, Go and fight against them.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.
verses.decoded: The Israelites approached the Benjamites for battle on the second day.

verses.kjv: And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men; all these drew the sword.
verses.decoded: Benjamin went out from Gibeah against them on the second day and killed eighteen thousand men of the children of Israel; all of these used the sword.

verses.kjv: Then all the children of Israel, and all the people, went up, and came unto the house of God, and wept, and sat there before the LORD, and fasted that day until even, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.
verses.decoded: Then all the Israelites and all the people went up and came to the house of God, and they wept and sat there before the LORD, and fasted that day until evening, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel enquired of the LORD, (for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days,
verses.decoded: The Israelites asked the LORD for guidance, because the ark of the covenant of God was there at that time,

verses.kjv: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days,) saying, Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease? And the LORD said, Go up; for to morrow I will deliver them into thine hand.
verses.decoded: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days, saying, Should I go out to battle again against the children of Benjamin, my brother, or should I stop? And the LORD said, Go up; because tomorrow I will give them into your hand.

verses.kjv: And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.
verses.decoded: Israel placed men lying in ambush all around Gibeah.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.
verses.decoded: The Israelites went to fight against the tribe of Benjamin on the third day and arranged themselves for battle against Gibeah, just like they had done before.

verses.kjv: And the children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to smite of the people, and kill, as at other times, in the highways, of which one goeth up to the house of God, and the other to Gibeah in the field, about thirty men of Israel.
verses.decoded: The people of Benjamin went out to fight against the Israelites and were drawn away from the city. They began to strike and kill some of the Israelites, as they had done before, on the roads—one road leading to the house of God and the other to Gibeah in the open country—about thirty men of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the children of Benjamin said, They are smitten down before us, as at the first. But the children of Israel said, Let us flee, and draw them from the city unto the highways.
verses.decoded: The men of Benjamin said, "They are being struck down in front of us, just like before." But the men of Israel said, "Let's retreat and lure them out of the city onto the roads."

verses.kjv: And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place, and put themselves in array at Baaltamar: and the liers in wait of Israel came forth out of their places, even out of the meadows of Gibeah.
verses.decoded: And all the men of Israel got up from where they were and arranged themselves in battle formation at Baal-tamar; and the men lying in wait for Israel came out from their hiding places, even from the meadows of Gibeah.

verses.kjv: And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and the battle was sore: but they knew not that evil was near them.
verses.decoded: Ten thousand selected men from all Israel came against Gibeah, and the battle was fierce, but they did not realize that disaster was close to them.

verses.kjv: And the LORD smote Benjamin before Israel: and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men: all these drew the sword.
verses.decoded: And the LORD defeated Benjamin in front of Israel, and the Israelites killed twenty-five thousand one hundred men of Benjamin that day; all of them fought with the sword.

verses.kjv: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten: for the men of Israel gave place to the Benjamites, because they trusted unto the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah.
verses.decoded: So the people of Benjamin saw that they were defeated because the men of Israel allowed the Benjamites some room, since they trusted the ambushers they had placed near Gibeah.

verses.kjv: And the liers in wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers in wait drew themselves along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.
verses.decoded: The men lying in ambush hurried and rushed into Gibeah; the men lying in ambush moved stealthily and struck down the entire city with the sword.

verses.kjv: Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the liers in wait, that they should make a great flame with smoke rise up out of the city.
verses.decoded: There was an agreed signal between the men of Israel and the ambushers, that they would create a large fire with smoke rising from the city.

verses.kjv: And when the men of Israel retired in the battle, Benjamin began to smite and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons: for they said, Surely they are smitten down before us, as in the first battle.
verses.decoded: And when the men of Israel retreated in the battle, the men of Benjamin began to strike and kill about thirty men of Israel, because they said, Surely they are defeated before us, just like in the first battle.

verses.kjv: But when the flame began to arise up out of the city with a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them, and, behold, the flame of the city ascended up to heaven.
verses.decoded: But when the fire started to rise from the city with a column of smoke, the Benjamites looked back, and saw that the fire from the city was going up to the sky.

verses.kjv: And when the men of Israel turned again, the men of Benjamin were amazed: for they saw that evil was come upon them.
verses.decoded: When the men of Israel turned back, the men of Benjamin were terrified because they realized that disaster had come upon them.

verses.kjv: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel unto the way of the wilderness; but the battle overtook them; and them which came out of the cities they destroyed in the midst of them.
verses.decoded: So they ran away from the men of Israel toward the wilderness; but the battle caught up with them, and those who came out of the cities were destroyed among them.

verses.kjv: Thus they inclosed the Benjamites round about, and chased them, and trode them down with ease over against Gibeah toward the sunrising.
verses.decoded: So they surrounded the Benjamites on all sides, chased them, and easily trampled them down near Gibeah toward the east.

verses.kjv: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men; all these were men of valour.
verses.decoded: Eighteen thousand men from Benjamin died; all of them were brave warriors.

verses.kjv: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon: and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men; and pursued hard after them unto Gidom, and slew two thousand men of them.
verses.decoded: They turned and ran toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon. They picked off five thousand men from them along the highways, chased them closely to Gidom, and killed two thousand of them.

verses.kjv: So that all which fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword; all these were men of valour.
verses.decoded: So all the men of Benjamin who died that day were twenty-five thousand men who fought with the sword; all of them were brave men.

verses.kjv: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon, and abode in the rock Rimmon four months.
verses.decoded: But six hundred men turned around and ran away to the wilderness at the rock Rimmon, and stayed at the rock Rimmon for four months.

verses.kjv: And the men of Israel turned again upon the children of Benjamin, and smote them with the edge of the sword, as well the men of every city, as the beast, and all that came to hand: also they set on fire all the cities that they came to.
verses.decoded: The men of Israel turned back against the people of Benjamin and killed them with the sword, including the men of every city, the animals, and everything they could find. They also set on fire all the cities they reached.

verses.kjv: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpeh, saying, There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife.
verses.decoded: Now the men of Israel had made a solemn oath at Mizpeh, saying, None of us will give his daughter to a man from Benjamin as a wife.

verses.kjv: And the people came to the house of God, and abode there till even before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept sore;
verses.decoded: The people came to the house of God and stayed there until evening in the presence of God. They raised their voices and wept deeply.

verses.kjv: And said, O LORD God of Israel, why is this come to pass in Israel, that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel?
verses.decoded: And said, O LORD God of Israel, why has this happened in Israel, that today there is one tribe missing in Israel?

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
verses.decoded: The next day, the people got up early, built an altar there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel said, Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the LORD? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the LORD to Mizpeh, saying, He shall surely be put to death.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel asked, Who among all the tribes of Israel did not come with the group to the LORD? Because they had made a serious oath about anyone who did not come to the LORD at Mizpeh, saying, That person must be put to death.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel felt sorry for Benjamin their brother and said, "One tribe has been wiped out from Israel today."

verses.kjv: How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?
verses.decoded: How can we provide wives for those who remain, since we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them any of our daughters as wives?

verses.kjv: And they said, What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpeh to the LORD? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabeshgilead to the assembly.
verses.decoded: And they asked, Which one of the tribes of Israel did not come up to Mizpeh to the LORD? And, look, no one came to the camp from Jabesh-gilead to the assembly.

verses.kjv: For the people were numbered, and, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabeshgilead there.
verses.decoded: The people were counted, and look, there were no inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead there.

verses.kjv: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest, and commanded them, saying, Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabeshgilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the children.
verses.decoded: The assembly sent there twelve thousand of the strongest men and commanded them, saying, Go and kill the people of Jabesh-gilead with the sword, including the women and the children.

verses.kjv: And this is the thing that ye shall do, Ye shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman that hath lain by man.
verses.decoded: And this is what you will do: You will completely destroy every male, and every woman who has slept with a man.

verses.kjv: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabeshgilead four hundred young virgins, that had known no man by lying with any male: and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
verses.decoded: They found among the people living in Jabesh-gilead four hundred young women who had never slept with a man, and they brought them to the camp at Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.

verses.kjv: And the whole congregation sent some to speak to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably unto them.
verses.decoded: The entire assembly sent some people to talk to the people of Benjamin who were at the rock Rimmon, and to peacefully call out to them.

verses.kjv: And Benjamin came again at that time; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabeshgilead: and yet so they sufficed them not.
verses.decoded: And Benjamin returned at that time; and they gave them wives whom they had kept alive from the women of Jabesh-gilead; but even so, they were not enough for them.

verses.kjv: And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.
verses.decoded: And the people felt sorry for Benjamin because the LORD had caused a gap in the tribes of Israel.

verses.kjv: Then the elders of the congregation said, How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?
verses.decoded: Then the leaders of the assembly said, How will we provide wives for the men who are left, since the women from Benjamin have been destroyed?

verses.kjv: And they said, There must be an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe be not destroyed out of Israel.
verses.decoded: And they said, There must be land given to those who escaped from Benjamin, so that a tribe is not completely destroyed from Israel.

verses.kjv: Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters: for the children of Israel have sworn, saying, Cursed be he that giveth a wife to Benjamin.
verses.decoded: However, we cannot give them wives from our daughters because the people of Israel have sworn, saying, 'Cursed is anyone who gives a wife to Benjamin.'

verses.kjv: Then they said, Behold, there is a feast of the LORD in Shiloh yearly in a place which is on the north side of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.
verses.decoded: Then they said, Look, there is a feast of the LORD in Shiloh every year in a place that is on the north side of Bethel, on the east side of the road that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.

verses.kjv: Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards;
verses.decoded: So they instructed the people of Benjamin, saying, Go and hide in the vineyards;

verses.kjv: And see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.
verses.decoded: Look, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance, then each of you come out of the vineyards, take a wife for yourselves from the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain, that we will say unto them, Be favourable unto them for our sakes: because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war: for ye did not give unto them at this time, that ye should be guilty.
verses.decoded: And it will happen, when their fathers or their brothers come to us to complain, that we will say to them, Be kind to them for our sake: because we did not keep each man his wife during the war: for you did not give them wives at this time, so you should not be guilty.

verses.kjv: And the children of Benjamin did so, and took them wives, according to their number, of them that danced, whom they caught: and they went and returned unto their inheritance, and repaired the cities, and dwelt in them.
verses.decoded: The people of Benjamin did as they were told and took wives for themselves, matching their number, from the women who danced, whom they captured. Then they went back to their land, rebuilt the cities, and lived in them.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel left that place at that time, each man returning to his tribe and his family, and each man went from there to his own inheritance.

verses.kjv: In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did that which was right in his own eyes.
verses.decoded: At that time, Israel had no king; each person did what they thought was right.
